title: Operations Lead - Digital Agency
description: GROWING AUSTRALIAN WEB DESIGN AGENCY This is a developing role within a growing agency. Your responsibilities will evolve as we scale, and we're looking for someone who's energised by that, not unsettled by it. ABOUT THE ROLE You'll be the operational backbone of our web builds. You'll work alongside our outsourced developer, taking projects from the build phase through to launch and ongoing optimisation. You're detail-oriented, process-driven, and you thrive when systems run smoothly. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WILL INCLUDE - Configure WordPress environments on SiteGround for outsourced developers, ensuring clean handoff and security protocols. - Build new WordPress sites using Elementor, working from HTML mockups and our existing templates and SOPs. As the role develops, identify opportunities to create new templates and refine existing processes. - Manage live site tweaks, design refinements, and plugin configuration post-launch. - Oversee site migrations to new domains, manage DNS, SSL certificates, and hosting configurations. - Apply basic on-page SEO during builds and launches (meta titles, descriptions, alt text, heading structure). Strategy and content come from us; you handle the on-page setup. - Create and maintain SOPs and process documentation (written guides and Loom videos) to systematise your work and support team scaling. - Handle administrative tasks including client communication, invoicing support, and basic business operations when build queue allows. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Strong WordPress knowledge with hands-on experience building and troubleshooting sites. - Familiarity with Elementor/Hello theme and Astra/Spectra - Experience with plug ins, online forms and integrations (Elementor native forms, WP mail STMP) and experience integrating booking solutions into client websites (Amelia, Calendly, or similar) - Solid understanding of hosting, domains, DNS, SSL, and basic server management. - Detail-oriented with a genuine interest in systems and processes. - Excellent written communication in English. - Ability to work independently and manage your own time within agreed hours. - A growth mindset - you're comfortable learning new tools and adapting as the business evolves. Nice-to-haves (not essential): SEO experience, schema markup knowledge, extensive plug in knowledge for higher end sites, CRM integration knowledge, Automation experience (workflow - to connect forms, bookings and business tools) ABOUT YOU You're process-driven and detail-focused. You enjoy documenting how things work. You communicate clearly, ask good questions when instructions are ambiguous, and you follow through. You're reliable, honest, and you want to be part of something that's building. We're a small, family-oriented business. We value people who share that ethos - people who care about doing good work and building something sustainable. THE ROLE IN NUMBERS Full-time: 40 hours per week, ideally 7am-4pm Manila time (9am-6pm AEST Brisbane time). Partial overlap is fine. Salary: PHP 40,000 starting, with review at end of probation (3 months) and annually thereafter. The range is PHP 40,000-60,000 depending on experience and growth. Benefits: 13th month pay (standard in Philippines). Health insurance (HMO) available. Start date: Ideally within 4-6 weeks. Flexible for the right person. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT We'll review applications as they come in and will only contact shortlisted candidates. If you don't hear from us this round, thank you for applying, and please consider applying again as new opportunities open up. We're taking our time to find the right person, so the hiring process may move quickly or slowly depending on the applications we receive. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a 16Personalities assessment (free, takes 12 minutes) as part of our screening process. We also use paid DISC profiling for final candidates at our cost. APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS To apply, please include in your application: - Your CV and links to 3 live WordPress sites you've built or significantly contributed to launching. - A brief written response (2-3 sentences) to this question: Tell us about a process or system you improved at a previous job, and how you documented it. - Your 16Personalities result (take the free test at ---------- and paste your profile type and key insights). - A short Loom video (3-5 minutes max) walking us through one of the WordPress sites you've built - what you did, why you made certain choices, and what you'd do differently now. This shows us how you think and communicate. In your email subject line, include the phrase "I understand the role is developing" so we know you've read this properly. We're looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Ecommerce Administrative Assistant (Operations + Notion + Shopify) — Full-Time
job_title: Ecommerce Administrative Assistant (Operations + Notion + Shopify) — Full-Time
description: We are a category-leading women’s eCommerce brand on a mission to create premium, affordable, and 100% waterproof jewelry that enhances our customers’ everyday lives. We’ve served over 1,000,000 customers worldwide in more than 145 countries! We’re hiring one or more sharp, proactive Administrative Assistants to support operations and execution across the business. This is not a “basic VA role.” If you need reminders, struggle with details, or prefer slow-paced work, this role will not be a fit. We are looking for someone who is: • fast, organized, and detail-obsessed • proactive (you spot issues before being asked) • fluent in Notion (databases + task systems + SOPs) • fluent in Shopify (orders + products + inventory fields) • able to work reliably with Dubai time (Gulf Standard Time, UTC+4) Working Hours (Dubai Time Requirement) This is a full-time role with consistent daily coverage. To be considered, you must have consistent availability in Dubai time (UTC+4). Required working hours: 8 am – 4 pm Dubai time (UTC+4), Monday–Friday. Please do not apply if you cannot reliably cover these hours. What You’ll Own (Core Responsibilities) 1) Operations Execution + Coordination • Maintain internal task systems in Notion (databases, assignees, due dates, SOPs) • Support daily operations tracking (orders, stock, shipments, urgent issues) • Create structure: checklists, templates, and systems to keep execution clean 2) Shopify Admin Support • Process and monitor orders, returns, and exchanges • Update product listings and key Shopify admin fields accurately • Maintain operational accuracy across inventory / pricing / product details (basic Shopify fluency is required — this is not optional) 3) Admin & Team Support • Scheduling, calendar coordination, meeting agendas, notes, follow-ups • Document management, data entry, reporting, and structured file organization • Ensure tasks don’t slip through cracks (high ownership required) • You will be expected to spot problems, propose solutions, and keep execution moving without needing constant direction Additional Support Areas (As Needed) This is primarily an operations + admin role. If you have additional skill, you may also support: • light marketing coordination (uploading, scheduling, simple assists) • invoice tracking / basic bookkeeping support • research projects (suppliers, competitor scans, simple analysis) Requirements (Must-Haves) • 2+ years of experience as an admin assistant, operations assistant, or eCommerce VA • Strong Notion fluency (databases, templates, task systems, SOP organization) • Strong Shopify fluency (orders, products, admin navigation, accuracy) • Extremely strong attention to detail • Excellent English communication (written + verbal) • Able to work full-time and maintain Dubai time coverage Bonus if you have: • Richpanel or other helpdesk tools • eCommerce fulfillment coordination experience • spreadsheet reporting experience If you’re a high performer, this role can become a long-term, career-defining growth path inside our company. Competitive pay based on experience. How to Apply Please complete this application carefully (we will not review low-effort submissions): ----------

description: Are you ready… To start a role that motivates and excites you? And a position where we invest in your learning, education, and growth? Then keep reading, we want to work with you! ABOUT US: We’re a young, ambitious, and small (but growing!) company that’s making a massive impact in ecommerce. Since 2015 we’ve been obsessed with building award-winning products and awesome brands that people fall in love with. We have 2 primary brands in our portfolio: (1) an international award-winning coffee products brand ---------- / ---------- ). (2) an educational coaching program that helps entrepreneurs grow their businesses to create a positive impact in the world! Our two recent flagship products became the world’s most successful launches in their categories. We’ve shipped more than 200,000 orders worldwide and we’re continuing to expand. Our culture is transparent and candid. You’re always welcome (and encouraged!) to ask questions or express a difference of opinion. Learning and growth is a cornerstone of our culture, both personally and professionally. We work hard, and we have fun! WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR: We’re looking for a proactive and detail-oriented team player to fill this role—someone who thrives on solving problems, staying organized, and making things run smoothly across departments. Do you love helping customers, supporting a team, and keeping operations organized? Do you get satisfaction from making systems work better and “getting things done”? If yes, we want you on our team! You’re probably the type of person who: • Enjoys supporting others and finding solutions to problems • Has strong communication and organizational skills • Likes working behind the scenes to make sure everything runs like clockwork • Is excited to wear multiple hats and be part of a growing, fast-moving company • Has worked directly with founders or in a startup, and enjoys that fast-paced, flexible vibe We’re not just looking for someone who can support our team, we’re looking for someone to be proactive with taking ownership of tasks, solve problems independently, and grow into larger responsibilities over time. YOUR OPPORTUNITY AND ROLE ON THE TEAM: Our culture is collaborative, friendly, and open. We hire people who are smart, ambitious, and have a strong desire to learn and grow. Sound like you? This is an exciting long-term opportunity! This is a fully remote position. You’ll work directly with our founders and collaborate with our small but mighty team to support customer happiness, streamline operations, and take on projects that help the business grow. This is a foundational role — one where you’ll gain visibility into all parts of the company. As you grow, your role will grow with you, based on your interests and strengths: • Want to work improving our systems and processes? Awesome! • Have ideas on how to improve our website? Fantastic! • Want to learn how to manage projects? Let’s go! We’re not just hiring for a role — we’re hiring for potential. Your responsibilities will span 4 key areas: customer experience (30-40%), operations/logistics (20-30%), executive support (10-20%), and special projects (10-20%) — giving you exposure across the business. These percentages are estimates and you can expect your day-to-day to shift and evolve as the business grows and as you take ownership. 1. Customer Experience • Provide email /chat-based support for our customers across our channels (Shopify, Amazon, and wholesale) • Answer order and product questions, resolve issues promptly, and ensure customers feel heard and supported • Support wholesale partners with order updates, invoicing, and coordination 2. Order Management & Platform Coordination • Manage, monitor, and troubleshoot orders across Shopify, Amazon, and wholesale channels • Troubleshoot and resolve shipping or fulfillment issues with partners and customers • Maintain accurate product listings, inventory data, and logistics information across platforms 3. Executive & Admin Support • Manage founder and team inboxes, schedule meetings, and organize internal documentation • Assist with travel bookings, meeting preparation, and note-taking • Support small projects by tracking timelines, managing tasks, and ensuring follow-through 4. Special Projects & Company Operations • Conduct research projects to support decision-making (tools, systems, competitors) • Support lead generation efforts through identifying new wholesale prospects, brand partners, or influencers • Support planning and execution of events, expos, or marketing campaigns — manage timelines, logistics, and tasks • Document and maintain SOPs for operational clarity and training • Test and troubleshoot web pages, workflows, or customer journeys to ensure quality and functionality • Take ownership of ad hoc “figure it out” tasks — we’ll guide you, but we value initiative and independent problem-solving mindset You’ll be trained on all platforms and tools, and we’ll support your learning — but we’re looking for someone who’s excited to take initiative and build systems along the way. This role evolves — as you grow, so will your responsibilities. ABOUT YOU / REQUIRED SKILLS OR EXPERIENCE: We value curiosity, reliability, and the ability to take ownership. If you enjoy figuring things out, learning on the job, and taking initiative, you’ll thrive here. This role is not a fit if you need constant direction or struggle to manage your own time. Must have experience: • 2+ years of experience in a customer service or operations support role (email /chat-based) • 1+ years experience in eCommerce environments (Shopify, Amazon, etc.) • Fluent in written and spoken English Key traits: • Strong detail orientation, organizational, and time-management skills — you’re detail-obsessed and on top of things • Proactive problem-solver — you take initiative, do the research, and follow through • Able to work independently, ask questions when needed, and communicate clearly • Comfortable with constructive feedback and direct, respectful communication Optional but a big plus: • Experience coordinating projects, events, or marketing campaigns is a plus • Experience with executive assistant work (email /calendar/travel management) • Experience improving or documenting processes (SOPs) • Experience at a startup or small business where you wore multiple hats • “Experience coordinating projects, events, or marketing campaigns is a plus” PAY, WORKING HOURS, HOW TO APPLY If this description seems like it’s too intimidating for you, this position is probably not for you. However, if you’re still here reading and this sounds exciting for you, we’d love to meet you! The full time monthly salary will be $ ---------- based on your skills and level of relevant experience. Being a member of our team has other benefits including up to 16 days of paid time off per year. We understand you may have a busy schedule, so we’ve made our interview process extremely quick and efficient. To apply, please follow the steps below: 1. Get started with a quick Initial Screening here for us to get to know you: ---------- 2. Complete the screening and we’ll be in touch with next steps once we receive it. The position is on a first come first review basis, so the sooner you complete the screening, the more likely you'll get hired. Good luck, and we hope to have someone awesome like you to join us!

We know what we're doing, we know what good work looks like, and we hold our team to a high standard. Our customers are emotional dog owners going through hard times. A negative comment sitting publicly for 2 hours costs us conversions. Brand Growth Initiatives (10% of role — and this is where you earn raises): Proactively reach out to happy customers and ask them to share their dog's story and video content with us. This is HIGH ROI for the brand. We use this content on our website and social media for social proof and trust. Identify patterns in customer issues and report them to us so we can fix root causes Help maintain and improve our Claude Projects with brand knowledge so our entire support system gets smarter over time Bring ideas. Be creative. Add value to the brand beyond just answering tickets. REQUIRED Experience (Non-Negotiable) If you do not have ALL of the following, please do not apply: Claude (Anthropic AI) — Advanced level — You use Claude regularly, you understand prompting, you know how to use Projects, you know how to feed context, and you know how to guide Claude to produce on-brand output. Not "I've heard of it." Actual hands-on experience. Shopify — You have worked in a Shopify admin panel before, can issue refunds, look up orders, check fulfillment status, etc. Brand social media management — You have managed Facebook and Instagram for a real business before. Who We Are NOT Looking For Anyone who needs to be told what to do every day Anyone who cuts corners or sends generic copy-paste replies Anyone who lets rude customers fluster them or push them around Anyone who lets rude customers get their way just to end the conversation Anyone who treats this like a 9-5 they clock in and out of Anyone who is applying to 20 other jobs and will leave in 3 months Anyone who can't take direct, honest feedback Anyone who thinks AI is a fad or "cheating" We had a previous VA who did the bare minimum and hid behind appearing busy. description: CUSTOMER SERVICE SPECIALIST - ECOMMERCE (DROPSHIPPING) Remote | Part-Time | 4-6 Hours Per Day | 7 Days a Week $3-4 per hour (approximately PHP 209/hour) | Growth opportunities for long-term contributors ------------------------- This is a long-term role. We are not looking for someone for one month. We want someone we can grow with, give more responsibility to, and pay more over time. Our existing CS team has been with us for years, and we want the same for this new hire. ------------------------- ABOUT THE ROLE You will handle customer email tickets for our Shopify-based ecommerce dropshipping brand. That means working through an inbox of 80 to 100 tickets per shift in Gorgias: order status inquiries, cancellation requests, returns and refunds, damaged or lost package cases, and size or quality complaints. You will use our documented SOPs and reply macros to resolve cases consistently, professionally, and with care. This is not a chat role, not a phone role, and not a social media role. It is email ticket handling in Gorgias, every day. ------------------------- WHAT YOU WILL DO - Reply to customer email tickets in Gorgias using our documented SOPs and reply macros - Hit team KPIs on First Response Time (FRT) and resolution time - Coordinate with our Supply Chain and Disputes teams when cases require handoff - Process refunds, replacements, and partial refunds within the approved decision tree - Escalate cases that fall outside policy to the CS Manager with a clear summary - Flag products with recurring complaints to the Quality team on a weekly basis - Keep clean notes on tickets so handoffs are seamless ------------------------- WHAT YOU WILL HAVE FROM DAY 1 - A full Customer Support SOP covering every scenario you will encounter - Gorgias reply macros for common situations (cancellations, RTS, damaged items, lost in transit, and more) - A Risky Products SOP for weekly product quality reporting - Direct access to the CS Manager for escalations and questions - An existing CS team to learn from, not a brand new setup You do not need to invent the playbook. We have built it. You need to execute it cleanly and consistently. ------------------------- REQUIREMENTS - Hands-on experience in ecommerce customer support, dropshipping customer support, OR Shopify-based CS (any combination works, dropshipping experience is a strong plus) - Experience with Gorgias OR a comparable ticketing tool (Zendesk, Reamaze, Freshdesk). Direct Gorgias is preferred but we can train on it quickly if you have strong Zendesk experience. - Comfort handling 80 to 100 tickets per shift without falling behind - Strong written English: clear, empathetic, and professional - Reliable internet and your own computer Bonus (not required): - Prior experience handling RTS (return-to-sender) situations - Familiarity with chargebacks and dispute processes in dropshipping - Prior experience with EU customers and their return expectations ------------------------- SCHEDULE - READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING This role is 7 days a week, every week. Our customers email every day including weekends and public holidays. If you cannot commit to working 7 days a week, please do not apply. We will not make exceptions, and applying anyway only wastes both our time. You can flex your specific working hours within the day as long as tickets are handled within our FRT target. ------------------------- COMPENSATION DETAILS Paid weekly via Wise. Rate grows with performance and tenure, we promote from within for team leads and specialist roles. ------------------------- HOW TO APPLY Read this section carefully. Applications that do not follow these instructions will be rejected without review. 1. Put the word BALI in your subject line. Nothing else is required in the subject. 2. In your application message, answer these 4 questions in order. Answer each inline, no attachments, no Loom videos at this stage. Q1. How long have you worked in ecommerce customer support, what kind of responsibilities did you have, and for what type of companies (dropshipping, DTC, marketplace, etc.)? Name the actual companies and your role there in detail. Q2. Describe one difficult customer ticket you resolved. What was the issue, what did the customer want, and how did you handle it? Keep it specific. Q3. What ticketing tools have you used (Gorgias, Zendesk, Reamaze, Freshdesk, etc.)? What ticket volume per shift have you typically handled, and what is the most you have ever handled in a shift? Q4. Confirm your availability: hours per day, days per week (we need 7), and your working hours in your local timezone. Also confirm: are you currently employed, and if yes, what would your start date look like? ------------------------- We read every application that follows the instructions. We are looking for one person for the long term, not a roster of temporary help.

title: Bookkeeper / Admin / Revenue Control (QuickBooks + Excel)
description: We're a growing flower business looking for a detail-obsessed bookkeeper who genuinely enjoys making numbers tie out to the penny. You'll own the daily financial pulse of the business — tracking every sale across Shopify, cash, and Zelle, reconciling team logs against actual payments, and catching discrepancies before they become problems. This is not a passive data-entry role. We need someone who notices when something doesn't add up and digs until they find out why. What You'll Do Daily (the core of the job): *Record all sales across Shopify, cash, and Zelle in QuickBooks *Reconcile the team's daily sales logs against actual payments received *Track inventory movement (incoming, sold, remaining, wastage) *Flag discrepancies, missing items, or anything that looks off *Submit a daily report summarizing sales, cash position, and any variances Weekly: *Maintain Excel reports for sales, inventory, and cash trends *Prepare a weekly summary report for the owner Reconcile bank activity and payment processor payouts As needed: *Respond to customer messages when the team is tied up *Support the owner with light admin tasks tied to financial operations What We're Looking For Required: *Real QuickBooks experience (you can explain the difference between a sales receipt and an invoice without thinking) *Strong Excel skills — pivot tables, SUMIFS, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and you build formulas, not just formatted tables *Multi-channel sales reconciliation experience (ideally Shopify + cash + a digital payment app like Zelle, PayPal, GCash, etc.) *Honest, calm, and methodical — you document your work and aren't defensive when asked to explain it *Clear English communication, written and spoken *Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for the daily report Bonus points for: *Retail or perishable inventory experience *Bookkeeping for a US-based small business *Experience reconciling Shopify payouts (you know payout timing and fee handling) What This Job Is Not *It's not a place to learn QuickBooks from scratch — we need someone who already works in it daily. *It's not a 9-to-5 with someone watching over you. You'll work independently, which means missed reports are immediately visible. *It's not a stepping stone — we want someone who'll grow with us for at least 18–24 months. Bonuses and pay increases are tied to performance and tenure. How to Apply Send the following to ---------- 1. A 1–2 minute voice recording answering this question: "Walk me through how you would handle this situation — at the end of the day, the team's sales log shows $1,847 in cash sales, but the cash drawer only has $1,790. What do you do?" 2. A sample of your bookkeeping or Excel work — a sanitized reconciliation, sales report, or inventory tracker you've actually built. Screenshots or files are fine. Templates downloaded from the internet don't count. 3. A short note with: *Your years of QuickBooks experience *Your current timezone and weekly hours of availability *One sentence on why this role fits you right now Applications missing any of these three items will not be reviewed. We're serious about detail — the application itself is the first test.

title: Operations Coordinator (VA)
description: About Alpha Key Digital Alpha Key Digital is a digital marketing agency specializing in patient acquisition for cosmetic surgeons, dermatologists, medical spas, and cosmetic dentists. We’ve been in business for 10 years, serve 12 retainer clients, and are growing. We’re a small team that operates with precision. No bloat. No unnecessary meetings. Clear communication, clean systems, and work that gets done when it’s supposed to get done. We are looking for a Virtual Assistant to take operational, administrative, and coordination tasks off the founder’s plate so he can focus on client strategy, business development, and growth. This is a high-trust role. You will be the person who keeps the engine running behind the scenes. The Role: Virtual Assistant / Operations Coordinator. Full-time. Remote. Must have significant overlap with US Eastern business hours. You are the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. The founder runs the client relationships and the strategy. You run the operational backbone that supports it: email triage, project management, scheduling, contractor coordination, content posting, and prospect list management. You don’t wait to be told what to do. You see the gap and you close it. This is not a customer-facing role. You will not be talking to clients directly. You will be the person behind the curtain making sure every deliverable, every email , every task, and every calendar event is where it’s supposed to be so the founder can walk into any conversation fully prepared. You’d Be a Great Fit If You Are The person who builds the checklist before anyone asks for one. You organize by instinct, not because someone gave you a system to follow. You create the system. Reliable to the point where people stop checking your work because they already know it’s done. You don’t need reminders. You are the reminder. Someone who reads the full email before responding. You catch the detail in the third paragraph that everyone else misses. You ask the clarifying question before it becomes a problem. Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision. You don’t need daily check-ins to stay productive. You need clear expectations and then space to execute. Proactive about surfacing problems early. If something is off, you flag it immediately instead of hoping it resolves itself. You know the difference between handling it yourself and escalating it. Disciplined with time. You batch similar work together. You don’t context-switch 15 times a day. When you’re in a task, you finish it before moving on. Protective of other people’s calendars. You treat the founder’s schedule like a strategic asset, not a suggestion. If something doesn’t belong on the calendar, you say so. Someone who takes pride in clean systems. Your Asana is current. Your inbox is processed. Your files are named correctly. You don’t leave loose ends. What You Actually Do Email and Communication Management Triage the founder’s inbox daily. Flag urgent items, draft responses for routine email s, archive what doesn’t need attention. Manage Slack communication with the white-label development team (E2M) and contractors. Relay updates, follow up on late deliverables, keep threads organized. Ensure no email or message sits unanswered for more than 24 hours during business days. Project Management and Task Coordination Own Asana: create tasks from briefs, assign to the right team member, track deadlines, follow up on overdue items, and keep the board clean. Coordinate deliverables between the founder, PPC contractor, SEO team, and E2M web development team. You are the traffic controller. Run a weekly check on all active client projects to confirm nothing is behind schedule. Surface delays to the founder before the client notices. Calendar and Scheduling Manage the founder’s calendar. Schedule client meetings, prospect calls, internal huddles, and personal appointments. Protect time blocks. The founder has dedicated strategic work time that should not be interrupted by meetings. You enforce that. Confirm and send reminders for all meetings. No missed appointments. LinkedIn and Prospect List Management Schedule LinkedIn posts (batch-created by the founder) using a scheduling tool. Export connection lists from Ulinc (LinkedIn automation tool) and organize prospect data in spreadsheets. Maintain and clean prospect lists. Tag, sort, and update contact records as the outbound pipeline grows. Send LinkedIn event invitations to targeted lists for webinars (up to 1,000/week). Copy, paste, send. Content and Social Media Support Post pre-approved content to social media channels on schedule. You are not creating the content. You are making sure it goes live when it’s supposed to. Upload and schedule video content (case studies, testimonials) to appropriate platforms. Basic Canva edits for social media graphics if needed. Reporting Support Pull data from Google Looker Studio dashboards for monthly client reports. You are not analyzing the data. You are making sure the reports are assembled and ready for the founder to review. Track basic metrics the founder requests (Ulinc connection rates, LinkedIn post engagement, email open rates). What You Are Not Doing Talking to clients. The founder owns all client relationships until a Client Success Manager is hired. Setting strategy or making campaign decisions. You coordinate. You don’t decide. Financial work. No bookkeeping, invoicing, or payment processing. Writing original content, ad copy, or marketing strategy. You post and schedule what others create. You are the operational backbone that frees the founder to do the work only he can do. Qualifications Required Two or more years of experience as a virtual assistant, operations coordinator, or executive assistant supporting a founder or small team Proficiency in Asana or a comparable project management tool (ClickUp, Monday, Trello) Proficiency in Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) Proficiency in Slack or a comparable team messaging tool Strong written English. Clear, professional, no errors. Reliable internet connection and a quiet, distraction-free workspace Available during US Eastern business hours (minimum 6 hours of overlap with 8am-5pm ET) Proven ability to work independently, manage your own time, and meet deadlines without being chased Preferred Experience supporting a digital marketing agency or a B2B service business Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and LinkedIn posting/scheduling Familiarity with Google Looker Studio (pulling reports, not building them) Experience with Canva for basic graphic edits Experience with Zapier or Make for workflow automation Familiarity with CRM tools (GoHighLevel, Close, HubSpot, or similar) Experience coordinating with offshore or white-label teams across time zones Tools You Will Use Daily Asana: project and task management Gmail / Google Workspace: email , docs, sheets, calendar Slack: internal team communication LinkedIn: posting, scheduling, connection list management Ulinc: exporting connection data, managing prospect lists Weekly Google Looker Studio: pulling client reporting data Canva: basic social media graphic edits Zoom / Loom: scheduling and coordinating video calls and async video Compensation and Details Full-time position Remote (global, any location with reliable internet) Must have significant overlap with US Eastern business hours (minimum 6 hours, 8am-5pm ET) Compensation commensurate with experience and location Reports directly to the founder Start date: as soon as the right person is found How to Apply Apply at the link below. You will complete a short application form and then record video responses to 7 questions. The whole process takes about 15 minutes. ---------- Three things we look for in every application: Did you read the full job description? (We can tell.) Can you communicate clearly and professionally in writing? Do you show evidence of working independently without needing to be managed? Generic applications will not receive a response.

title: GUEST COMMUNICATION & AI OPERATIONS ASSOCIATE
description: ABOUT OODA OODA Management is a San Diego-based short-term rental property management company building the next generation of how short-term rentals are run. Short-term rental management is hard to scale. Every property is different, every guest is different, and every situation requires judgment. Most companies either deliver great personalized service at small scale, or they grow and the service quality quietly falls apart. We are building the company that does not make that trade. We are small and AI-native by design. We use AI tools, automation, and tight operating systems to deliver service at a level legacy property managers cannot match without hiring far more people. Guest communication is one of the most important parts of that system. This role starts with guest messaging, but the long-term opportunity is helping us build the guest communication engine of an AI-native property management company. ABOUT THE ROLE This is a guest communication role with an AI operations growth path. Your first responsibility is simple and important: make sure guests receive fast, clear, calm, professional support. You will respond to guest messages, follow SOPs, escalate issues, update internal systems, and help ensure guests feel taken care of during their stay. But this is not just a message-answering job. At OODA, every guest message is also a signal. A guest asks a confusing check-in question. Why was it confusing? A guest reports an issue late at night. What information do we need? A guest asks the same thing five other guests asked. Should we update the template? A situation keeps repeating. Should AI handle it next time? A message could have been prevented. What was missing from the instructions? We are looking for someone who can handle the guest professionally today, then help us make the system better tomorrow. You do not need to be a programmer. You do not need to have a deep technical background. But you should be comfortable with software, interested in AI tools, and excited to learn how automation can improve operations. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS Most guest messaging jobs are simple: answer questions, follow scripts, close tickets. This is different. OODA is building a system where human judgment and AI work together. Guest communication is one of the main places where that happens. The person in this role will help us understand: What guests ask most often Which messages require human judgment Which messages can eventually be automated Where our instructions are confusing Where our SOPs need improvement Where AI responses are helpful Where AI responses need correction What information the team needs to make better decisions This role is for someone who wants to become excellent at guest communication and then help us build a smarter system around it. The starting point is guest support. The growth path is ownership. WHAT YOU WILL DO Your work may include: Responding to guest messages across Airbnb, property management tools, email , SMS, and other channels Answering questions about check-in, checkout, WiFi, parking, amenities, house rules, and property details Helping guests with access issues, unclear instructions, maintenance concerns, cleaning issues, and other stay-related problems Following SOPs and message templates while still sounding natural and human Keeping every conversation calm, clear, and professional Updating internal systems so the team knows what is happening Escalating maintenance, cleaning, access, or guest experience issues correctly Tracking repeated guest questions and recurring problems Helping improve message templates, SOPs, and internal notes Using AI tools like ChatGPT to draft, summarize, classify, and improve communication Reviewing AI-generated messages for accuracy, tone, and guest experience Helping identify which guest questions can be safely automated Helping train and refine AI-assisted guest communication over time You will not be expected to build software. But you should be excited to work inside a company where the goal is to make the system better every week. THE BIGGER OPPORTUNITY This role starts at 10 to 25 hours per week. We are starting part-time intentionally. The first phase is about learning our properties, tools, guest standards, SOPs, and escalation rules. For the right person, this can become full-time after the initial period. As OODA grows, the guest communication function will need people who can own more responsibility. That may mean expanded hours, team leadership, quality assurance, SOP ownership, AI training, guest messaging management, or a more specialized AI operations role. The best people in this function will not just answer messages. They will help define how guest communication should work. That means: Better guest templates Better escalation rules Better AI prompts Better training examples Better quality control Better reporting Better internal notes Better workflows between guests, vendors, cleaners, and the operations team We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the function, not just complete a shift. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for someone who is: COMMUNICATION Excellent in written English Strong spoken English preferred Clear, calm, warm, and professional Able to write naturally, not robotically Able to communicate with guests who are tired, confused, frustrated, or in a hurry Able to follow templates without sounding like a script TEMPERAMENT Calm under pressure Reliable during the agreed schedule Detail-oriented Patient with guests Comfortable handling multiple conversations at once Able to work independently during overnight coverage Hungry for more responsibility over time JUDGMENT Knows when to solve and when to escalate Does not overpromise Does not ignore details Can follow SOPs carefully Notices patterns in repeated guest issues Thinks in root causes, not just one-off replies Can be trusted with guest-facing communication SYSTEMS AND AI Comfortable learning new software tools Comfortable using ChatGPT or willing to learn quickly Interested in AI, automation, systems, or process improvement Able to review AI-generated messages and d ---------- whether they are accurate and appropriate Excited by the idea of helping train AI-assisted guest communication over time You do not need to be a developer. But you should be the kind of person who says: “I answered the guest correctly, but why did they need to ask this in the first place?” That mindset matters. THIS ROLE IS A STRONG FIT IF YOU Have experience in guest messaging, customer support, hospitality, virtual assistance, or operations Have supported U.S.-based customers or guests before Can write excellent English without sounding robotic Are comfortable working U.S. Pacific Time hours Can handle multiple chats or messages at once Stay calm when guests are upset or confused Like improving templates, SOPs, and processes Are interested in AI tools and automation Want to grow into a larger role over time Are based in the Philippines and comfortable working remotely Bonus points if you have experience with: Airbnb Hospitable Guesty OwnerRez Hostaway Slack ClickUp Notion Google Sheets ChatGPT or other AI tools Short-term rental operations Customer support QA SOP creation Process improvement Guest messaging management Night shift or overnight support THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF Please do not apply if: Your written English is weak You only want a basic VA task list You dislike following processes You get flustered when guests are upset You do not want to learn new tools You are not interested in AI, systems, or process improvement You want a role where you only do what you are told and never think critically You cannot work reliably during the agreed schedule You are uncomfortable being measured on quality, reliability, and improvement We are not looking for someone who just “handles messages.” We are looking for someone who wants to master guest communication and help us build a better operating system around it. THE QUALITY BAR Because written English is the core of this job, here is the standard. You should be able to write messages like these naturally: “Hi Sarah, thanks for reaching out. I’m sorry about the confusion. Let me check this for you right now and I’ll follow up shortly.” “You’re all set. The cleaner confirmed the item was found, and we’ll coordinate the best way to get it back to you.” “I understand how frustrating that must be. I’ve escalated this to our maintenance team and will keep you updated as soon as I hear back.” Clear. Calm. Human. Accurate. That is the bar. WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE BY 30 DAYS You understand our properties, tools, SOPs, and guest communication standards You can handle routine guest messages with limited help Your written replies are consistently clear, warm, and professional You escalate the right issues to the right people You are dependable during your assigned schedule BY 90 DAYS You can independently handle most guest messaging situations Your judgment is reliable enough that the operations team trusts your decisions You have identified recurring guest questions or workflow problems You have suggested improvements to templates, SOPs, or escalation rules You are using AI tools to improve speed and quality BY 180 DAYS You are not just running the workflow, you are improving it You have helped implement concrete improvements to guest communication You are contributing examples, feedback, and ideas that improve AI-assisted operations You are becoming a true owner inside the guest communication function, not just a message responder EXAMPLE OF THE MINDSET WE WANT A normal guest messaging person says: “The guest asked for the WiFi, so I sent the WiFi.” A great person in this role says: “The guest asked for the WiFi, so I sent it. But this is the fifth time guests have asked this property for WiFi this month, so maybe the check-in instructions are unclear. I recommend adding WiFi to the first arrival message.” That is the difference. A normal guest messaging person says: “The guest said the door code did not work, so I escalated it.” A great person in this role says: “The guest said the door code did not work, so I escalated it. But I also checked whether the code was sent correctly, whether the guest was at the correct door, and whether this has happened before at this property.” That is what we are looking for. SCHEDULE AND GROWTH PATH This role starts at 10 to 25 hours per week. Coverage during U.S. Pacific Time hours is required. Overnight guest support is part of this role. We are starting part-time intentionally. The first phase is about learning the business, proving reliability, showing strong judgment, and demonstrating that you can handle guest communication with increasing independence. For the right person, this can become a full-time role after the initial period. As OODA grows, we want to build long-term roles around the people who prove they can own real parts of the operation. That may mean expanded hours, full-time contractor work, a formal employment role, quality assurance ownership, team leadership, or a more specialized AI operations position. This is not a short-term task list. It is an entry point into the operating team of a company being built for scale. WHEN YOU MESSAGE US When you message us, please briefly tell us: Your guest messaging, customer support, hospitality, VA, or operations experience Your availability in U.S. Pacific Time Your desired hourly rate What tools you have used before Whether you have used ChatGPT or other AI tools Why this role interests you beyond basic guest messaging Also include the word PINEAPPLE at the top of your message so we know you read the full post.

The right person will help take tasks off my plate, keep things organized, follow up on details, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. About the Role This role includes a mix of: * Executive assistant work * Family assistant work * Personal admin * Business admin * Travel planning * Research * Scheduling * Follow-up * Documentation * AI-enabled systems and organization We need someone who can take messy information and turn it into something clear, organized, and useful. Business Support You may help with: * Managing email inboxes * Prioritizing important messages * Drafting replies using clear instructions and templates * Responding to basic customer inquiries * Organizing leads, clients, and follow-ups * Updating Google Sheets, documents, and internal trackers * Scheduling calls, lessons, meetings, and reminders * Creating SOPs, checklists, and process documents * Following up with contractors, tea ---------- mbers, students, and vendors * Organizing files, links, documents, and business resources * Helping with basic business research * Supporting tools like Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Sheets, HubSpot, Kajabi, Circle, CoachNow, Stripe, or similar platforms Family & Personal Support You may help with: * Organizing family travel between the United States, Australia, and other locations * Researching flights, hotels, transportation, visa requirements, and travel options * Building clear travel itineraries * Comparing travel options in simple summaries * Tracking important family dates, appointments, bookings, and reminders * Helping organize personal documents and family schedules * Researching services, products, appointments, or vendors * Helping keep household and family admin organized * Making sure logistics are handled before they become stressful AI-Enabled Operations This is very important. We are looking for someone who actively uses AI to improve how they work. This does not mean simply using ChatGPT to write email s. We want someone who can use AI to: * Organize messy information * Summarize email s, documents, and conversations * Create checklists and SOPs * Research and compare options * Build repeatable workflows * Improve follow-up * Reduce mistakes * Save time * Turn repeated tasks into better systems The right person should be able to look at a task and think: * How can this be done faster next time? * How can this become a checklist or SOP? * How can AI help organize the information? * How can AI help reduce missed details? * How can this become less dependent on me? You do not need to be a developer. But you do need to be resourceful, curious, and comfortable using AI as a serious productivity tool, not just a writing assistant. Good Examples of AI Use Good examples would include: * Turning a messy email thread into a clear action list * Summarizing travel options into a comparison table * Creating an SOP from a repeated task * Building a checklist for future use * Organizing meeting notes into next steps * Creating a follow-up tracker * Researching options and presenting the best choices clearly * Finding a way to make a repeated admin process faster next time Bad examples would be: * “I use ChatGPT to write email s” * “I ask AI for ideas” * “I copy and paste things into ChatGPT” That is not enough for this role. Requirements You must be: * Excellent in written English * Highly organized * Detail-oriented * Reliable * Proactive * Trustworthy with private information * Good at following instructions * Good at asking smart questions when something is unclear * Comfortable working independently * Comfortable doing research * Comfortable using AI tools to improve your work * Comfortable with both business and family/personal tasks * Comfortable with Google Docs, Google Sheets, Gmail, Google Calendar, and common online tools Work Schedule This is a full-time role. You must be available to work the schedule we set for the role. Some overlap with US Central Time is required. The schedule may change depending on business and family needs. Please do not apply if you are only looking for flexible hours or if you cannot work during the required schedule. Pay Please include your expected monthly salary in USD. We are looking for the right long-term person, so there is room to grow in responsibility over time. Who This Is For This role is for someone who enjoys bringing order to chaos. You should like organizing details, creating systems, checking things off, following up, and helping busy people stay on track. You should be comfortable handling both business tasks and family logistics. You should not need every single step explained forever. We will provide direction and training, but over time, we want someone who can take ownership and improve how things are done. Who This Is Not For This is not a good fit if: * You only want basic task work * You wait for every single instruction * You are not comfortable using AI * You only use AI for writing basic email s * You dislike organizing details * You struggle with follow-up * You miss deadlines * You are uncomfortable handling both business and personal tasks * You do not like building checklists, systems, or repeatable processes How to Apply Use this exact subject line when applying: SYSTEMS Applications that do not include SYSTEMS in the subject line will not be reviewed. What experience do you have as a VA, executive assistant, personal assistant, family assistant, or admin assistant? 3. Have you helped with travel planning before? Give a specific example. 4. What AI tools have you used before? 5. Give a specific example of how you have used AI to improve a workflow, organize information, automate part of a task, or make a repeated process easier. Do not only describe using AI to write email s. 6. What tools have you used before? For example: Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Sheets, HubSpot, Kajabi, Stripe, ClickUp, Notion, etc. 7. What is your expected monthly salary in USD? 8. Are you looking for a long-term full-time role? Final Note We are looking for someone who can become a valuable long-term part of our team. The right person will help us stay organized, save time, reduce stress, improve follow-up, and create better systems across both business and family logistics. If you are reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, and serious about using AI to work smarter, we would love to hear from you.

description: ABOUT US We are a family-owned hair salon based in Southern California that has been operating for over 20 years. Our specialty is color and highlight services, and our clients are primarily women aged 35 to 65 who come back to us for years. Over the past year, we've built out a Meta ads funnel using GoHighLevel as our CRM and phone system, and we're now generating a steady flow of inbound leads from Facebook and Instagram. I'm hiring one full-time appointment setter to handle all of those leads and book them into the salon. This is a long-term role. I'm looking for someone who wants to stay with us for at least a year and grow into the position. WHAT YOU'LL DO You will be the only person responsible for converting our inbound leads into booked appointments. - Work inbound leads from our Meta ads through call, SMS, and DM (Facebook and Instagram) inside GoHighLevel - Run our booking script as written: discovery questions, offer presentation, and the card-on-file close - Handle objections using the framework I will train you on (reframe value, build trust, induce gentle urgency without being pushy) - Send Stripe payment links to capture the card on file, then book the appointment in our calendar - Charge the card on file in Stripe for any late cancels or no-shows (a few minutes per day) - Log every interaction cleanly in the CRM so I can review conversion data and refine the script over time The most important ---------- nt on every call is getting the card on file. Once we have it, our show rate jumps from around 55% to 90%, so that is the part of the script that matters most. KPI TARGETS This is a high-volume, metrics-driven role. You will know exactly how you are performing every day. - Calls per day: 150 to 250 - Leads worked per day: 17 to 25 - Lead-to-booking rate: 25% or higher - Show rate: 90% or higher (after card on file) - Bookings per day: 4 to 9 - Showed appointments per month: 100 to 160 WHAT I NEED YOU TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING Script adherence is a dealbreaker. We need you to follow the script word for word on the key parts of every call. We use conversion data to test what's working and what isn't, and if everyone is freestyling their own version, the data is useless. If you have ideas to improve the script, we genuinely want to hear them, but you raise them with as feedback, not by changing things on calls. The schedule is fixed. Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time. For someone in the Philippines, that is 11:45 PM to 8:45 AM PHT (an overnight shift). No exceptions, no shift swaps, no occasional late starts. I need someone who has actually worked overnight shifts before and knows they can sustain it for at least 12 months. Tech reliability is non-negotiable. The role does not work if your internet drops two or three times a week. I will ask about your backup plan (mobile hotspot or second ISP), and we will test your connection and audio live from your actual work setup before any offer. REQUIREMENTS - 6 to 12 months of phone-based sales, appointment setting, or BPO experience (4+ hours per day on the phone) - Clear, neutral English with strong listening skills (you'll be talking to US-based women aged 35 to 65 all day) - Comfortable with high call volume (150 to 250 dials per day) and a long-term commitment to that pace - Strong script discipline and comfort operating inside a defined process - Reliable home office setup: 8GB RAM minimum (16GB preferred), wired headset with boom mic, computer mouse, internet at 25 to 50 Mbps down and 10 to 20 Mbps up, ping under 50ms, and a real backup internet plan you have actually used - Available Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time (overnight in the Philippines) NICE TO HAVE - Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (CRM and phone) - Experience with Stripe payment links - Background in B2C inbound sales (beauty, wellness, fitness, medspa, or salon) - Personal interest in beauty, hair, or self-care COMPENSATION - Base: $900 USD per month - Performance bonuses: $3 per new client show, $2 per existing client show, $1 per rebooking show - Monthly threshold bonuses (cumulative): +$75 at 90 shows, +$150 at 120 shows, +$350 at 150 shows - On-target earnings: approximately $1,300 to $1,815 per month - PTO: 14 days per year after a 90-day probation period - Payment: Paid through ---------- on a regular schedule - Equipment: I will buy you a headset if you need one. Computer and internet are yours. To be straightforward about the structure: roughly 30 to 50% of your monthly income will come from performance bonuses. If you want a high guaranteed base with low expectations, this isn't the right fit. If you want a clear path to earn more by actually performing, the math works well here. Your home internet speeds (down/up) and your backup plan 4. Whether you can commit to the Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM PST schedule for at least 12 months

Please include a current speedtest.net screenshot showing your download speed, upload speed, and ping — and tell us in your email what internet plan you have and whether you're on Ethernet or WiFi. A quiet home office. No background noise on calls — no roosters, no traffic, no kids, no neighbors. Backup power or a hotspot in case of outages is a strong plus. ID Proof verified on your OnlineJobs.ph profile — we only review applications from ID-verified accounts. Familiarity with any customer service or e-commerce tools (Richpanel, helpdesks, e-comm platforms, email tools) — list anything you've used Other work skills that could help a small company — bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, scheduling, anything you do well We'll watch your video and read your application. If we like you, we'll reach out. At that point we'll ask you to obtain an NBI Clearance — we'll reimburse the fee. Schedule Full-time, 40 hours per week Paid twice monthly Long-term role — we're hiring carefully because we want to grow with the right person How to apply (please read carefully — incomplete applications will not be reviewed) In your email , please include all 6 items below. We sort applications by who followed every instruction — not by who applied first. At the very top of your email , write the word “Buddy” in bold. (This is so we know you read all the way to the end of this post.) Tell us in 2–3 sentences: are you a dog person? Why? Record a 1–3 minute video covering the four prompts described below, and get it to us any way you want — attach the file, paste a YouTube unlisted link, Google Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer, anything that works. Attach a screenshot of a current speedtest.net result showing your download speed, upload speed, and ping. In the email , also tell us what internet plan you have at home and whether you're on a wired Ethernet connection or WiFi. List any customer service, e-commerce, admin, or office software / tools you have used (for example: Richpanel, Gorgias, Zendesk, Help Scout, Shopify, WooCommerce, Klaviyo, QuickBooks, Google Workspace — anything you actually know). List one or more previous employers who can speak to how good your customer service is. The more the better — but one is fine if that's all you have. Video prompts (1–3 minutes total, single take, no editing) Please cover all four of the following in your video, in any order you like. There's no script — just talk to us like you'd talk to a customer. Introduce yourself. Your first name, where you live in the Philippines, and one thing about you that's not on your resume. Tell us about your customer service background. Where you've worked, who your customers were, and — especially — what your phone customer service experience has been like. What kinds of calls did you handle? How often were you on the phone? What were your callers like? Why this role? Tell us what you're looking for in your next job and why customer service for US pet owners feels like a fit for you. What else can you do? Customer service is the main job — but a person with extra skills is gold to a small team like ours. If there's another work skill you have that could help our company (bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, scheduling, etc.), tell us briefly about it. If customer service is your only area, just say so — that's a fine answer. Tips: Record in a quiet room. Audio clarity matters more than video quality. Use your phone or webcam. We want to hear the real you. 1 minute minimum, 3 minutes maximum. Going under or over is a soft red flag — it tells us how you'd manage time on a real call. If your application is missing any of items 1–6, or if your video is over 5 minutes or under 1 minute, we will not review it. We're being strict because we're hiring carefully — not because we don't respect your time.

description: ABOUT US We are Integrative Medical, a regenerative medicine clinic in the Phoenix, AZ, Metro area. We have been serving our community since 2012, and we pride ourselves on warm patient experience, efficient care, and personalized attention. Our small team values professionalism, kindness, accountability, and getting things done right the first time. WE ARE HIRING A VIRTUAL FRONT DESK ASSISTANT A friendly, sharp, and proactive VA to be the front-desk voice of our clinic — and to help with other projects during idle time. This is a long-term role for someone who wants stability, variety, and a workplace that values upbeat, solution-oriented people. ABOUT THE ROLE You'll be the first point of contact for patients calling our clinic. Between calls, you'll handle scheduling, administrative work, outreach to new patients and clients, and a rotating mix of VA tasks for other projects we run. No two days look exactly the same. We'll provide structured onboarding, SOPs, and training on our systems — you don't need to know our specific tools on day one, but you do need to be a fast learner. WHAT YOU'LL DO (CLINIC) - Answer incoming patient calls professionally and warmly - Schedule, reschedule, and confirm appointments - Handle administrative tasks using office software (Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, etc.) - New patient onboarding and outreach (calls, email s, follow-ups) - New client outreach and lead follow-up - Other front-desk and admin duties as needed WHAT YOU'LL DO (OTHER PROJECTS, DURING IDLE TIME) - General virtual assistant tasks across our other business projects - Research, data entry, email management, document prep, light project coordination - Whatever is needed to keep things moving — we'll always brief you clearly This varied mix is part of the role itself. As you grow into the position and demonstrate strong performance, responsibilities and pay can expand over time. TEAM & REPORTING You'll be our first and only VA hire, reporting directly to the doctor. Your day-to-day interactions will primarily be with patients and other callers — you'll be the front-line voice of the clinic. MUST-HAVES - Excellent spoken English — clear, neutral, easy to understand on the phone - Excellent written English — professional, error-free email s and messages - Upbeat, cheerful, positive personality (this matters — patients can hear it) - Proactive and solution-oriented — you spot problems and bring fixes, not just questions - Comfortable with office software (Google Workspace and/or MS Office, calendar tools, spreadsheets, basic docs) - Reliable internet, quiet workspace, working headset, and a backup power/internet plan - Long-term commitment — we are not looking for short-term help - Comfortable handling confidential patient information. As a medical clinic, we operate under HIPAA. You'll be required to sign a confidentiality agreement and Business Associate Agreement (BAA) before you start, and to follow our patient privacy protocols on every call and every record. - Able to work US business hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Phoenix/Arizona time (roughly 12:00 AM – 9:00 AM Manila time). Please only apply if you're confident you can work and thrive on this schedule long-term. NICE-TO-HAVES - Prior experience in a medical, dental, or healthcare front-desk role - Experience with US clients - Familiarity with EMR/EHR systems, scheduling platforms, or VoIP phone systems - Experience with CRMs or outreach tools EQUIPMENT & TOOLS You provide: - A capable computer that can smoothly handle VoIP calls while running our CRM, EHR, and office software at the same time (minimum 8GB RAM, ideally 16GB; modern processor; Windows or Mac) - An excellent noise-cancelling USB headset — clear audio quality is essential since you'll be speaking with patients - High-speed, reliable internet (at least 25 Mbps) with a backup connection (second ISP or mobile hotspot) - UPS or backup power for brownouts - A quiet, private, distraction-free workspace — this means a home office or dedicated room. Working from a call center, BPO floor, or shared workspace is not acceptable — patients must hear only you on the line. We provide: All clinic software and logins (EHR, scheduling, CRM), a HIPAA-compliant VoIP phone system for patient calls, training materials, and SOPs. SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION - Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Phoenix/Arizona time (8.5 hours work + 30-minute unpaid lunch break) - Type: Full-time (42.5 hours/week paid) - Pay: $500–$650/month USD, based on experience - 90-day probation period. During this time, we'll evaluate fit on both sides. After successfully completing probation, you'll receive a formal performance review, paid time off and sick leave begin accruing, and the 13th month bonus becomes effective. - Performance-based raises after probation, with annual reviews thereafter PAID TIME OFF (after 90-day probation) - 10 days paid vacation per year, accruing monthly - 5 days paid sick leave per year - Paid time off when the clinic is closed for US holidays (you work your regular schedule on days the clinic is open) PAYMENT - Paid in USD, semi-monthly on the 1st and 16th of each month - Sent via Remitly, received in your GCash wallet - 13th month bonus paid in mid-December START DATE We're aiming to fill this role within 4–6 weeks of posting. We're willing to wait for the right long-term fit, including reasonable notice periods if you're currently employed. HOW TO APPLY Please send the following: 1. A short message telling me why this role is a fit for you 2. Your resume / CV 3. A short video (3–5 minutes) where you: - Introduce yourself - Walk me through your work experience - Share your top skills and strengths - Share one honest weakness you're working on To show you actually read this post, please open your application with two things: 1. Your current time zone, and confirmation you can work the hours listed above 2. One specific thing from this post that made you want to apply for this role Applications that skip these will not be reviewed. HIRING PROCESS 1. description: About this role: We are an Australian-based bridal lifestyle business operating two connected brands — an editorial bridal media platform and a luxury bridal product brand. About the Brands We operate two connected Australian brands in the bridal lifestyle space: Brand 1 — An editorial bridal media platform publishing articles across five content categories. Think high-end bridal magazine in digital format. Content covers styling, planning, venues, and honeymoon destinations. Brand 2 — A luxury Australian bridal product brand with its own Instagram, Facebook , and Pinterest presence. Both brands share a consistent visual aesthetic — soft, editorial, cinematic, and minimal. Everything you post must feel like it belongs to that world. Neither brand name is disclosed until after initial screening. The Role — What You Will Do This is a fortnightly batch role. Every two weeks you receive a complete content package containing everything pre-made and pre-written — article drafts, images, pin graphics, captions, and a scheduling calendar. You schedule and publish everything across all platforms according to the brief. No creative decisions are required from you. Your job in one sentence: Receive the fortnightly content package, match everything to the correct article and week, format and upload articles to WordPress for founder approval, and schedule all pins and social posts across Pinterest, Instagram, and Facebook in advance. Fortnightly tasks in full: VA hours — per fortnight (7-9 hours total): • WordPress formatting and upload (4-6 articles) — 2-3 hours • Brand 1Pinterest pin scheduling (20-30 pins) — 3-4 hours • Brand 2 Pinterest pin scheduling (4-6 pins) — 30-45 mins • Brand 2 Instagram and Facebook scheduling (4 posts each platform) — 40-60 mins • Completion report with screenshots — 20-30 mins Total VA hours per fortnight: 7-9 hours (3.5-4.5 hours per week averaged) What You Receive Each Fortnight Everything arrives in a shared Google Drive folder organised by week and article: All article drafts — edited and approved, ready for WordPress formatting All Pinterest pin graphics — pre-made, exported, and labelled by article and week All pin descriptions — written and ready to copy-paste All Brand 2 Instagram and Facebook images — pre-made and labelled by post date All captions — written and ready to copy-paste for every platform A scheduling calendar showing exactly which content publishes on which date IMPORTANT: You never write captions, choose images, make strategy decisions, or create graphics. All creative and strategic work is done before the package reaches you. Your role is accurate, timely execution from a detailed brief — every fortnight, without exception. Skills Required WordPress — comfortable formatting posts, uploading images, filling SEO meta fields, and working with a plugin like RankMath. Previous WordPress editing experience is essential. Pinterest Business — understands board structure, pin scheduling, and how to distribute pins across multiple boards correctly without triggering duplicate content flags. Meta Business Suite — can schedule posts to Instagram and Facebook simultaneously, understands caption format differences between the two platforms. Attention to detail — the most important skill in this role. You follow a brief exactly, every time, without shortcuts or assumptions. Reliable and consistent — the fortnightly deadline does not move. Completion reports are expected within 72 hours of receiving the package. Strong written English — you are copy-pasting provided captions but must read accurately and spot formatting issues before submitting. Discretion — you will be working with confidential brand materials. A signed NDA is required before onboarding. Preferred but not essential: Experience with lifestyle, bridal, fashion, or travel content brands Familiarity with editorial or magazine-style content aesthetics Experience with Pinterest scheduling Canva experience for minor template adjustments Rate & Structure Rate: USD $70 per fortnight on a fixed retainer. Hours: Approximately 7–9 hours per fortnight (14–18 hours per month). Flexible — you choose when within the 3–4 day completion window to do the work. Structure: Fortnightly batch. You receive the content package, complete all tasks within 3–4 days, submit your completion report with screenshots. Payment is fortnightly after successful completion of the scheduled tasks. Start date: Immediate — looking to onboard within 2 weeks of finding the right person. Long-term: This is an ongoing role with a growing brand. We are looking for someone who wants a reliable long-term working relationship, not a one-off project. What Success Looks Like Every article is correctly formatted in WordPress and set to Pending Review within 48 hours of receiving the package Every Pinterest pin is scheduled to the correct board with the correct description — no errors in board assignment or descriptions No pins saved to the same board twice on the same day Every Brand 2 social post is scheduled to publish on the correct date at the correct time Completion report with screenshots submitted within 72 hours of receiving the package Zero errors requiring the founder to fix before approving content How to Apply Please include all three of the following in your application. 1. Short introduction covering: Your experience with WordPress, Pinterest Business, and Meta Business Suite — be specific about what you have done on each platform Any lifestyle, bridal, fashion, travel, or editorial brands you have worked with Why a fortnightly batch role suits you and how you manage deadlines 2. Portfolio — at least two examples from: Screenshots of Pinterest boards or scheduled pins you have managed Screenshots of WordPress posts you have formatted and published Examples of Instagram or Facebook posts you have scheduled via Meta Business Suite 3. Complete this short test task: This takes approximately 15 minutes. Answer all three questions in your application. You have been given a Pinterest pin image about choosing a wedding veil for a ballgown dress, and the following description to post: "Choosing a veil for a ballgown dress comes down to one decision — length or drama, rarely both. A cathedral veil balances the volume of a full skirt without competing with it. Read the full guide on our editorial platform." Question 1: You have four boards available: (a) Wedding Veils, (b) Honeymoon Destinations, (c) Wedding Planning Essentials, (d) Bridal Style Inspiration. Which board would you save this pin to first, and which board — if any — would you save it to second? Explain your reasoning. Question 2: If you saved this pin to two boards, would you do both on the same day? Why or why not? Question 3: Before you set a WordPress article to Pending Review and submit your completion report, what are the three things you would check to make sure the article is correctly formatted? There are no trick questions. We are looking for someone who reads instructions carefully and thinks before acting. Brand names and full role details are shared only with shortlisted candidates after a brief screening call and a signed confidentiality agreement. We take the privacy of our brands seriously and expect the same from anyone we work with. I am keen to see applicants who actually read the brief with a response that is not generated by chat GPT.
