AI Literacy: Daily use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT or Claude) to optimize recruiting workflows. Communication: Fluent professional English, both written and verbal. Logistics: Reliable home office setup with backup power and internet. Work Hours and Benefits Schedule: Monday to Friday, requiring at least 4 hours of overlap with 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Mountain Time. Payment: Competitive monthly salary paid on the 15th and 30th via Wise. Environment: Join a 36-person fully remote team within a rapidly scaling company. How to Apply Application Form: Complete the form at ---------- Video Submission: Provide a 2–3 minute video covering your LinkedIn outreach process, your experience with high-volume triaging, and your current use of AI tools in recruitment. Hiring Process: Application review, structured interview, work sample (sourcing exercise), and final interview with the CEO. Expect a total process time of 2–3 weeks.

title: Team Lead Appointment Setter
description: Team Lead — Outbound Appointment Setting (Philippines, Work From Home) We're Hiring a Player-Coach. Not a Babysitter. Not a Cheerleader.Remote (Philippines-based) | Full-Time | Aligned to Mountain Time (Calgary, Canada) Competitive base salary + performance bonuses tied to your team's resultsIf you've run an outbound appointment-setting floor before, if you've coached agents from missing KPIs to crushing them, if you can sell, take a call yourself, overcome objections in your sleep, and hold the line on standards without needing your boss to remind you — keep reading.We're One Janitorial. We're a Canadian commercial cleaning company scaling fast across Canada and breaking into the USA. Our appointment-setting team is the engine of our growth — and we need a Team Lead who can run that engine at peak performance every single day.This is not an entry-level supervisor role. This is a true Team Lead role with a complete playbook, real KPIs, real accountability, and real money on the line. 5 to 10 setters will report directly to you. Their performance is your performance.What You'll Actually Own Every DayHit the KPI bar — across your whole team: 150+ dials per setter per day 4 hours of talk time per setter per day 1:25 average handle time 2.2 booked appointments per setter per week 1.3 sat appointments per setter per week If a setter misses their dials and talk time and doesn't book — you write them up the same day. No exceptions. No "they had a rough day." You hold the ---------- n 2 hours of coaching per day — minimum 8 coachings daily. Coach every setter at least twice per week Listen to calls through our CRM and identify each agent's #1 constraint Pull two real call examples that show the same constraint Run the full coaching process: play the calls, get them to spot the issue, demo the right way, roleplay back-and-forth until they nail the scenario 5 times in a row Record every session, post it in the coaching chat, send a coaching email with what was covered, follow up 20–40 minutes later to confirm they're applying it Review every booked appointment — the same day it's booked. Open the deal, listen to the full call with undivided attention, take detailed notes in the standard template Verify the appointment against our DQ criteria (residential, K-12, over 40K sqft, gatekeeper bookings, day porters, monthly/bi-weekly, etc.) DQ the bad ones and document why Coach the setter on what they did right and wrong Train new hires from scratch. Run the Day 1 kickoff with confidence and energy Take new hires through Trainual modules, Yoodli roleplays, live script practice, HubSpot and RingCentral training Review every Yoodli scenario — 10 perfect reps before they move on By Friday, you know who's a top performer and who's getting cut Documentation and reporting that doesn't slip: Daily Stats sheet updated and accurate EOD Coaching Tracker filled in for every coaching done Rebook tasks created for every no-sit appointment EOD Report sent at the end of the day with the team's metrics, appointment quality, and coaching summary Performance write-ups and PIPs drafted and sent when needed — using our exact templates Sell when you need to. You're not above the phones. If a setter is stuck on a gatekeeper or losing a deal to an objection, you jump on the line and show them how it's done. You know the script, the rebuttals, the qualifying questions, and the close. You can run a presentation yourself if you ever needed to.Who We're Looking ForThis role is for a real Team Lead. Not a "lead generator with a fancy title." Proven outbound appointment-setting background. You've been on the phones. You've hit 150 dials a day yourself. You know what cold calling feels like at 2 PM when your energy is low and you still have 60 dials left. Proven team lead experience. You've managed 5+ outbound agents before. You've coached them, written them up, put them on PIPs, fired them when needed, and developed top performers. You can sell and overcome objections. "Already in a contract." "Not interested." "Send me an email ." "I'm too busy." You have a clean, fast rebuttal for every one of them — and you can teach your team to do the same. You hold the line. No favorites. No exceptions. If the KPI bar is 150 dials, it's 150 dials for everyone — including the agent who's been there the longest. You enforce the standard without drama and without flinching. You're a company person. You're loyal to the system. You don't shortcut the coaching process. You don't let setters skip the DQ review. You don't make up your own version of the script. You run the playbook the way it's written — and if you see a way to improve it, you bring it to leadership the right way. You're a team player who knows the team wins when the standard wins. You build people up. You celebrate wins loudly. You handle losses privately and constructively. You give credit. You take blame. Excellent English — written and verbal. You'll be coaching agents who call Canadian and American business owners every day. Your accent, clarity, and tone need to be sharp. Discipline. You're at your desk on time. Your coaching schedule is locked. Your EOD report goes out on time. Your stats are accurate. Every day. No reminders needed. You know HubSpot, RingCentral, Google Sheets, and Notta — or you can pick them up fast. Reliable home setup — fast and stable internet, quality headset, webcam, and a quiet workspace. No background noise, no roosters, no construction. What You Get Strong base salary in UCAD (aligned to Philippines market rates for senior team lead roles — we pay more than the typical BPO) Performance bonuses based on your team's appointment booking and quality conversion rates Direct line to senior leadership in Canada — Peter Boland (CEO) and Omar (Operations) — you'll be in real conversations about the team, not buried under three layers of middle management Real career growth. As we expand into the USA Ambassador Program, we'll need Operations Managers, Sales Directors, and senior leaders. We promote from within. A complete playbook handed to you on Day 1. Scripts, coaching processes, call listening process, appointment review process, DQ criteria, write-up templates, PIP templates, EOD report templates, new hire training plan — all of it. Your job is to execute it, not invent it. ScheduleMonday–Friday, aligned with Mountain Time (Calgary, Canada). You'll typically be working evenings/overnight in Philippines time. Be honest with yourself about whether that schedule works for you long-term before you apply.How to ApplyStep 1 — Complete the application form: ---------- 2 — Submit a 2–3 minute video answering these three questions. Upload to Google Drive (set to "anyone with the link"), Loom, or YouTube (unlisted), and paste the link into the application form. Question 1: Walk us through your background in outbound appointment setting. How long were you on the phones yourself, how many dials per day, what was your booking rate, and what industries were you calling into? Question 2: Tell us about a time you had a setter on your team who was missing their KPIs week after week. What specifically did you do — coaching, write-up, PIP, termination? Walk us through the exact steps you took and how it ended. Question 3: A setter on your team books an appointment, but when you listen to the call, you realize they skipped half the qualifying questions and the prospect is clearly a gatekeeper, not the decision maker. Walk us through exactly what you'd do — with the setter, with the deal, and with the rest of the team. Your application will not be considered without the video. We watch every single one.The Hiring Process Application review (resume + video). We respond within 5 business days. 45-minute structured interview with our Talent Acquisition team — focused on your appointment-setting and team-lead background. 30-minute interview with the CEO — Peter will get into the details of how you coach, how you handle underperformers, and how you'd run our team specifically. Live work sample (60–90 minutes) — we'll give you a real recorded call from our pipeline and ask you to: (1) listen to it, (2) identify the setter's main constraint, (3) write up the coaching session, and (4) roleplay the coaching conversation with one of our managers playing the setter. Reference checks — 3 references required, including your most recent direct manager and at least one setter who reported to you. Final decision and offer. Full process: 2–3 weeks from application to offer for serious candidates.If you're the Team Lead we're looking for, this is one of the best roles you'll ever land. Real responsibility, real growth, real money, real respect — and a CEO who cares about the team and rewards results.If you've read this far and you're thinking "I can do this," — apply.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
job_title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description: READ THIS FIRST We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns for Hair Etc., a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California. This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, run a proven script, and book them onto the salon's calendar. If you're a sales-oriented setter who loves high-volume work, runs scripts the way they were written, and is motivated by performance pay tied to real results — keep reading. If you want a low-pressure customer service job or you like "making the script your own," this won't be a fit. IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY. OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses). 13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top. --- ABOUT THE COMPANY You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on Hair Etc., a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years. The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market. You can see the salon directly: - Google Maps Listing: ---------- - Instagram: ---------- You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at Hair Etc. handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked. A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time. We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't. --- WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support. Daily: - Call new Facebook /Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day) - Run our call script word-for-word for the entire call, from greeting to booking. The only time you go off-script is to answer a client's specific question (directions, timing) or collect unique info. - Respond to inbound SMS, Facebook ---------- , and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them - Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel - Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar - Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs - Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM) - Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers Weekly: - One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min) - Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings - Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them During training (first 2–4 weeks): We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence. --- A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY) We say "word-for-word" because that's how the role works — but we want to clear up the most common concern people have about that: "Won't I sound like a robot if I'm reading a script?" No. Think about the best actors in your favorite movies. They're saying lines someone else wrote. They don't sound robotic because they've rehearsed enough that the words feel natural, and they bring real warmth, tone, and presence to the delivery. THAT'S EXACTLY WHAT WE'RE AFTER. The script is the structure. Your tone, pacing, and warmth are what make it feel human. We train for this. You'll rehearse, get coached on tonality and pacing, and review your own call recordings until the words feel like yours — even though they're not. The setters who do this best sound like they're having a natural conversation that just happens to follow a proven path. The script DOES change over time — but only based on data. If something isn't landing in calls, we test a new version, measure the results, and update the script if it works better. What we don't do is let setters freelance individual changes on the fly, because then we can't tell what's working and what's not. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll genuinely consider it. We'll A/B test it together. If the data shows it works better, it becomes the newscript. That's the structured way changes happen here. If that framing works for you, you'll thrive. If "follow a script and let us measure what works" feels suffocating, this role won't be a fit. --- SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES) All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning. - US workdays: Monday through Friday - US days off: Saturday and Sunday - Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call) - Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March): Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT - A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time - A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time - Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night) Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November): - Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT - Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit. Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying. --- COMPENSATION Base pay: $900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month. 13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000. requests, missing order claims, product complaints, and shipping delays in line with our policies -Klarna and PayPal dispute resolution: hands-on experience responding to disputes on both platforms, title: Head of Operations
description: We are excited to announce a senior opportunity to join our rapidly growing women’s jewellery brand, D.LOUISE. We are one of the UK’s fastest-growing companies with an expanding footprint in the US and ambitious plans for international growth. We’re looking for a hands-on Head of Operations to serve as the CEO’s right hand and second-in-command — the operational backbone of the business and the connective tissue between product, marketing, e-commerce, logistics, CX and finance. You will own the operating rhythm end-to-end, run our inbound and outbound shipping across UK and US, and hold every function accountable to what they said they’d do. The ideal candidate isn’t a corporate “process admin” — you’re a builder-operator: someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, builds systems from the ground up, and treats the business like it’s your own. This role also requires someone who is genuinely AI-first — not curious about AI, but already using it every day to multiply their own output and their team’s. If that isn’t you, this role isn’t for you. Key Responsibilities Operating Rhythm & Execution • Own the operating rhythm: weekly trade, monthly planning, quarterly reviews, launch readiness — with the project management system as the single source of truth. • Hold function leaders accountable to commitments. Chase politely, firmly, and on time. • Give the CEO early-warning visibility on what’s on track, what’s at risk, and what needs a decision — by 6am UAE time, without messaging anyone. Logistics, Stock & CX • Own UK and US 3PLs as key accounts — SLAs, cost per order, dispatch performance — plus inbound freight, landed cost, customs, and cross-border compliance. • Own a single source of truth for stock across Shopify, 3PLs, and in-transit inventory; coordinate UK?US transfers; partner with merchandising and finance on forecasting and margin. • Oversee the CX function and its KPIs — someone runs the day-to-day; you hold them accountable, and make sure issues feed back into product, logistics and ops. AI, Systems & Reporting • Drive AI and automation adoption across operations — finding leverage, building workflows, replacing manual work. • Build SOPs and systems that work without constant oversight; recommend hires before capacity breaks. • Build dashboards that surface what matters — trade, stock, 3PL SLAs, CX, launch status, P&L — so the CEO can ask one question and get an answer with the receipts. You’re not a fit for this role if • You haven’t worked at a DTC e-commerce company. • You haven’t managed 3PL or vendor networks. • You haven’t built systems and SOPs from scratch. You’re a fit if • 5–10+ years in operations, logistics, or supply chain, specifically in DTC/e-commerce brands in the $10M–$50M revenue range. • Proven track record of building scalable systems (dashboards, SOPs, reporting) — not just maintaining corporate processes. • Hands-on experience managing international supply chains (China, US, EU), 3PLs, and vendors. • Strong financial acumen: margins, landed costs, forecasting, and cost optimisation. • Builder mindset. You roll up your sleeves, fix what’s broken, then scale it. • Comfort with chaos and urgency — making fast decisions, firefighting, and then creating structure. • Experience leading lean teams (3–15 people) in start-up or scale-up environments. • AI-first. Not “I’ve used ChatGPT.” You’ve built workflows, agents, or automations that have meaningfully replaced manual work. • Proficiency with tools like Shopify, Amazon, Notion, Slack, n8n, AI tools, and reporting dashboards (Google Sheets / Looker Studio / ERP). • Excellent communication with internal teams and external partners across geographies. • Flexibility to travel internationally (China, US, EU) a few times per year. How to Apply This is a senior, builder-operator role — so the application is itself part of the assessment. We want to see how you think, how you communicate, and how you operate before we sit down with you. We’re not interested in polished CVs alone. To apply, send us three things: 1. The Task — a written response (no longer than 1,000 words) Imagine you’ve been Head of Operations at D.LOUISE for 60 days. Prepare a written response covering: • Your assessment of the three biggest operational risks you’d expect to find in a business like ours (educated guesses are fine — we want to see your operator instincts). • A 90-day plan: what you’d prioritise, in what order, and why. • One specific AI/automation workflow you’d build inside the first 60 days — with a rough architecture: which tools, what it replaces, what it costs. • Three KPIs you’d put on the CEO’s dashboard from day one, and why. • One thing you’d ask the CEO to stop doing. Full creative freedom on format — Google Doc, Notion page, Loom walkthrough, whatever you’d naturally produce. We care more about how you think than how it looks. 2. A 2-5 minute Loom video Walk us though whatever project management system you use and how you would set it up for us 3. Your CV and a short note One paragraph on why this role specifically. No cover letter, no long essays. How we’ll handle applications • We review every application that follows the instructions. We don’t review applications that don’t. • Shortlisted candidates will hear from us within 7 days. • From there: a screening call, a deep-dive interview with the CEO, and a final stage with the leadership team. We aim to make an offer within 2–3 weeks of first contact.

title: Demand Planner & Inventory Analyst
description: Your job is to make sure the right stock is in the right place at the right time - across UK and US - for a fast-growing jewellery brand. Job Opportunity: Demand Planner & Inventory Analyst We are D.LOUISE, one of the UK’s fastest-growing women’s jewellery brands, with a rapidly expanding footprint in the US. We sell direct-to-consumer through Shopify and run UK and US 3PLs. We move fast, we run lean, and we use AI to multiply what a small team can do. We’re hiring a Demand Planner & Inventory Analyst to own one of the most important jobs in our business: making sure we have the right stock in the right warehouse at the right time, without tying up cash in overbuys or losing sales to stockouts. This is a deep, analytical, numbers-heavy role. You will live inside our WSSI, our PO process, our supplier relationships, and our stock dashboards. You are the person who flags a re-buy three weeks before anyone else notices we’re short. You are the person who spots that the US warehouse is overstocked on a SKU that the UK is selling out of, and proposes the transfer. This role also requires you to be AI-first — not curious about AI, but already using it every day to do more, faster, and better. If AI isn’t already changing how you work, this role isn’t for you. Key Responsibilities Inventory & Demand Planning • Own and maintain the WSSI/MSSI — weekly stock, sales and intake — across UK and US. • Forecast demand by SKU and channel. Flag re-buy risks early. Pressure-test supplier lead times. • Balance stock between UK and US warehouses to avoid overstock in one market while stocking out in another. • Minimise overbuys on slow lines, maximise availability on core lines, and keep buys aligned to the commercial budget and cash-flow forecast. Purchase Orders & Supplier Coordination • Own the PO process end-to-end — raise, track, chase, confirm receipt against the WSSI. • Maintain positive day-to-day relationships with suppliers and freight forwarders. Confirm terms, lead times, and shipment status. • Coordinate inbound freight from suppliers into UK and US 3PLs — importation, customs documentation, and clearance. Reporting & Stock Visibility • Build and maintain dashboards that surface stock health — cover, sell-through, ageing, intake vs forecast — visible to the leadership team. • Surface weekly insights: what’s at risk, what’s overstocked, what to re-buy, what to mark down. • Partner with finance on landed cost, margin, and cash-flow impact of buying decisions. You’re not a fit for this role if • You haven’t owned a WSSI/MSSI before in a real working business. • You haven’t worked in DTC e-commerce or retail. • You’re not strong in Excel / Google Sheets at a model-building level (pivots, lookups, advanced formulas, scenario modelling). • You see AI as a “nice to have” rather than core to how you work. You’re a fit if • 3+ years in demand planning, inventory analysis, merchandise planning, or buying — specifically in DTC e-commerce, retail, or fashion. • Hands-on experience with WSSI/MSSI to manage and report on stock-on-hand positioning. • Strong analytical thinker. You procure and treat data efficiently. Excel and Google Sheets are second nature — pivots, lookups, advanced formulas, scenario modelling. Bonus if you’ve worked with Looker, BigQuery, or ERP/inventory tools. • Sharp problem-solving instincts. You spot patterns and anomalies in data before anyone tells you to look. • Understanding of P&L structures — COGS, direct costs — and how product margins flow to the bottom line. • Understanding of e-commerce marketing activity and how it impacts demand (campaigns, promos, BFCM, paid spikes). • AI-first. You use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, n8n, automations) daily to make yourself more productive. You can show us examples. • Excellent written English. You’ll be communicating with UK / US teams and suppliers in writing, often async. • Comfortable in a small, fast-moving team. You can take on adjacent work when needed without losing focus on your core role. How to Apply Applications that don’t follow these instructions will not be reviewed. We’re looking for people who read carefully, follow instructions precisely, and care about detail. The application itself is your first test. 1. Put the word “Gold Jewellery” in the subject line of your application. If you don’t include this word, your application will be rejected without being read. This is how we know you actually read this job spec. 2. Record a 2-5 minute Loom video answering these three questions: 1. Walk us through a WSSI you’ve owned. What did it look like, and what did you do with it? 2. Tell us about one AI tool or workflow you use every day, and how it has changed your work. 3. Walk us through your screen — show us a recent Excel or Google Sheets model you built. Talk us through what it does. Don’t over-produce it. We’re looking at how you think and communicate, not your video editing. 3. Attach your CV and a one-paragraph summary of why you’re interested in this role specifically. If you pass the first round you will move onto a paid task.

title: Marketing Operations Coordinator – Cruise Travel
description: We are a specialised Australian travel business focused exclusively on the exciting world of cruise holidays. With an established and loyal customer base, a fast-growing membership community, and strong supplier relationships across more than 30 international cruise lines, we are expanding our team. We are looking for a highly organised, commercially aware, and proactive Marketing Operations Coordinator to become a key part of our business. This is not a basic admin role. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced marketing environment where timing matters, attention to detail is critical, and great execution directly impacts business growth. You will play an important role in helping us bring cruise offers to market quickly and effectively, keeping our members engaged and ensuring our promotions stay competitive. What you’ll be doing Your day will combine research, marketing execution, campaign coordination, and content support. This includes: • Monitoring competitor cruise promotions, offers, and pricing activity • Reviewing and analysing cruise deals received from more than 30 cruise line partners • Identifying standout promotions and helping prioritise campaigns • Creating engaging Facebook content for our private membership community • Preparing marketing assets using Canva • Assisting with our weekly email newsletter production in Mailchimp • Managing outbound email communications to our membership base • Working extensively in Excel to organise campaign information, compare offers, and maintain marketing data • Supporting our growing LinkedIn marketing presence • Responding quickly to time-sensitive promotions that need to be launched immediately This is a dynamic role where priorities can shift quickly depending on supplier offers and promotional opportunities. ________________________________________ About you You are someone who enjoys structure, speed, and getting things done. You are commercially minded and naturally curious—you like researching competitors, spotting opportunities, and understanding what makes an offer compelling. You communicate clearly in written English and are comfortable working remotely as part of a highly responsive team. You should ideally have experience in: • Excel (confident working with spreadsheets, formulas, comparisons, data organisation) • Canva (social graphics, promotional content, visual marketing materials) • Mailchimp (email campaign creation, formatting, audience handling) • Facebook business/social content creation • Online research and competitor analysis Bonus points if you have: • travel industry experience • cruise industry experience • digital marketing experience • LinkedIn content experience ________________________________________ Working arrangements • Full-time remote role, however we will be communicating during each workday through Messenger/Teams or similar • Monday to Friday • 8 hours per day • Start time between 7:00am and 9:00am Manila time • Fast communication is essential, as some campaigns move quickly • Competitive full-time salary based on experience, plus long-term opportunity with a growing Australian business. ________________________________________ Why join us? This is an opportunity to work with an established Australian travel business in a specialist niche with passionate customers and exciting products. You will become an important part of a growing business where your work will be visible, valued, and directly connected to results. If you enjoy travel, promotions, digital marketing, and working in a fast-moving team environment, we would love to hear from you. ________________________________________ To apply Please include 'Cruise Ready' in your subject line. Also provide: • examples of Canva work you have created • a brief explanation of how you have used Excel professionally • details of your Mailchimp experience • any relevant travel or digital marketing experience • your remuneration expectation Applicants not completing or complying with these requirements will not be considered. Thank you.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description: ROLE DESCRIPTION: Salesforce Administrator Department: Customer Success Reports to: Head of Customer Success Role Purpose: The purpose of this role is to enhance how Visualcare uses Salesforce across the Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk teams. Partnering closely with these teams, this role assesses how each function uses the platform day-to-day, identifies opportunities to improve workflows, and designs and builds the automations, dashboards, and data structures needed to support efficient, data-driven operations. This role plays an important part in ensuring Salesforce is well configured, well used, and trusted as the single source of truth for customer, lead, and account information at Visualcare, and works with leadership across Sales and Customer Success to ensure platform investment translates into measurable business outcomes. What are the requirements/credentials of an ideal candidate • 4+ years working hands-on with Salesforce in a configuration, administration, or build capacity, ideally within a SaaS or technology-driven environment • Demonstrated experience customising Salesforce — including building flows, process automations, validation rules, page layouts, custom objects, and approval processes • Strong skills in designing and building dashboards and reports that support day-to-day operations and leadership decision-making across multiple business functions • Experience partnering with Sales, Customer Success, and/or Customer Support teams to understand their workflows and translate operational needs into well-scoped Salesforce solutions • Proven experience managing data quality in Salesforce — including data audits, deduplication, cleansing, and lead/contact enrichment • Salesforce Administrator certification - Advanced Administrator, Service Cloud Consultant, Sales Cloud Consultant, or Platform App Builder certifications highly regarded • Systems thinker with a strong workflow orientation — able to map how work flows across people, processes, and tools, and design solutions that hold up at scale • High attention to detail with a disciplined approach to testing, documentation, and change management • Excellent communication skills — able to partner with non-technical stakeholders, understand their workflows, and translate requirements into clear technical solutions • Comfortable working across competing priorities from multiple business functions, with the ability to triage and sequence work transparently ? Key Areas of Focus: * Workflow Discovery & Solution Design (30%) -Partner with the Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk teams to understand how each function uses Salesforce on a day-to-day basis. -Identify workflow inefficiencies, operational gaps, and opportunities for process improvement across teams. Recommend practical and scalable Salesforce solutions aligned with business needs and priorities. Document both current-state and future-state workflows clearly for stakeholder alignment and ongoing business reference. *Salesforce Configuration & Automation (35%) -Build and configure Salesforce solutions including flows, automations, validation rules, custom objects, and page layouts. Implement workflow enhancements that reduce manual processes and improve operational efficiency across Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk functions. -Apply structured testing and change management processes to ensure system stability and user adoption. Maintain clear technical documentation for all configurations, automations, and system enhancements. * Reporting & Dashboards (20%) - Design and develop dashboards and reports that provide visibility into operational and team performance. -Translate business and operational requirements into actionable reporting solutions such as pipeline tracking, customer health monitoring, ticket volume analysis, and resolution metrics. -Ensure Salesforce data is properly structured to support accurate and meaningful reporting. -Continuously optimize dashboards and reports based on evolving business priorities and KPIs. *Data Cleansing & Enrichment (15%) -Conduct regular Salesforce data audits to identify duplicates, inconsistencies, and data quality issues. -Lead ongoing data cleansing initiatives to maintain Salesforce as a reliable source of truth. -Enrich customer and lead records with relevant supporting data to improve targeting, segmentation, and reporting accuracy. -Establish and maintain data quality standards, naming conventions, and governance processes to ensure long-term data integrity. ? Success measures • Salesforce workflows across Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk are continuously improved, with regular delivery of scoped, well-tested enhancements • Dashboards and reports are actively used by each business function and leadership for day-to-day decision-making • Measurable improvements in operational efficiency (e.g. reduction in manual handling, improved resolution times, improved pipeline visibility) against baselines agreed with each team • Salesforce data quality is consistently maintained — duplicates, gaps, and stale records reduced over time against agreed standards • Customer and lead records are appropriately enriched to support segmentation, targeting, and reporting • Strong, trusted working partnerships with the Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk teams, with clear and transparent prioritisation of competing requests IMPORTANT: Click here to apply in his position : ----------

title: Advanced Dispute Specialist (SALARY +BONUSES)
description: Who We Are Altura Funding is a business funding and capital solutions company based in Cleveland, Ohio. We move fast and we expect results. We are bringing our credit repair operations fully in-house and we need someone who already knows what they are doing — not someone we have to train from scratch. What This Role Is You will manage consumer credit dispute campaigns on behalf of our clients using legally compliant, aggressive dispute strategies under the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) and the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA). You will challenge inaccurate, unverifiable, and outdated negative items across all three credit bureaus. This is not a basic dispute role. We expect sophisticated, consumer-law-based strategies executed at high volume with fast turnaround. What You Will Do Draft and submit customized, consumer-law-based dispute letters to Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion Challenge negative items using FCRA Section 611 (accuracy and completeness), Section 605 (obsolete items), and Section 623 (furnisher responsibilities) Use FDCPA-based debt validation letters to challenge collection accounts Write goodwill adjustment requests, pay-for-delete proposals, and method of verification demands Track all dispute timelines, bureau responses, and client file updates with meticulous accuracy Coordinate with our team on client readiness for business funding as credit profiles improve Manage multiple client files simultaneously without missing deadlines Communicate client progress clearly and on schedule Who You Are You are not someone who logs into Credit Repair Cloud, DisputeBee, or any other platform and blasts out generic templates. We have seen what that produces and it is not good enough for our clients. We need someone who understands the law, knows how to craft custom dispute arguments, and can move the needle fast. You know that real results come from understanding why a negative item is on the report, identifying the correct legal angle to challenge it, and executing with precision. You do not guess. You do not wait. You know that bureaus have 30 days to respond and you use every tool available within that window to get results. If you need six months to start producing, this is not the role for you. Our clients need movement quickly and we expect to see results within the first 30 days of working a file. If you have a proven track record and documented results to show for it, we want to hear from you. If you do not, please do not apply. What You Must Have Minimum 2 years of hands-on credit dispute experience — not just using software, actually writing and managing disputes from strategy to resolution Deep working knowledge of FCRA, FDCPA, and Metro 2 compliance standards Ability to draft original, legally grounded dispute letters — not template blasts Experience working directly with all three major bureaus and their dispute processes Familiarity with credit repair platforms but the ability to operate beyond their built-in templates Extreme attention to detail and the ability to manage high volume without errors Strong written English communication skills Documented results you can show during the interview — we will ask What We Do Not Do We operate strictly within the bounds of federal consumer protection law. We do not promise specific score increases, we do not dispute accurate information, and we do not use deceptive or fraudulent practices. If that is not how you operate, this is not the right fit. Compensation Competitive base pay based on experience. Performance bonuses tied to documented client results. Long-term opportunity for the right person. To Apply Send your resume, a description of your credit repair experience, and at least two documented examples of dispute outcomes you have achieved for clients. Applications without proven results will not be reviewed.

Clear writing, sharp summaries, confident tone. You love closing loops. An exceptional organizer. You create clarity quickly and keep many moving pieces synchronized. Calm under pressure. You don’t spiral when things change—you prioritize and execute. A driver (high-D). You take initiative, make decisions, push progress, and hate dropped balls. A fast learner. Tools, design vocabulary, and new workflows don’t intimidate you. Process-minded. You don’t just survive chaos—you build systems that prevent it next time. Qualifications - 2+ years in an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, Project Coordinator, Producer, or similar role supporting a senior leader - Strong proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs) - Excellent written communication and professional judgment - Comfortable learning and operating inside tools like Notion / Asana / ClickUp / Trello (any is fine) - Ability to flex occasionally for time-sensitive deadlines (rare, but part of the job) Nice to Have (Not Required) Experience in interiors, design studios, architecture firms, creative agencies, or construction-adjacent environments Familiarity with procurement workflows, vendor coordination, timelines, and approvals Comfort with basic docs/slides and keeping shared drives organized What Success Looks Like (30/60/90) 30 Days Inbox and calendar are stabilized: organized, responsive, and prioritized A simple system exists for action items, follow-ups, and meeting notes Ishita is noticeably less reactive day-to-day because you’ve created structure 60 Days Project trackers are consistently up to date (milestones, approvals, open decisions) Communication threads are clean and proactive (fewer “just checking in” loops) Weekly cadence is running smoothly: status updates, blockers, and decisions are visible 90 Days Ishita’s schedule and focus time feel protected and intentional Dropped-ball rate is near zero You’re proactively improving systems and preventing problems before they happen Compensation & Growth Competitive salary (shared in later stages; commensurate with experience and location) Growth path: EA ? Senior EA / Operations Lead How to Apply (Required) Please submit all of the following: 1) Resume (PDF) 2) Loom Video (Required — 4–6 minutes max) Record one Loom (screen-share on). Include a link to the video in your application. We’re evaluating: clarity, prioritization, tone, judgment, and how you create structure fast. In your Loom, answer all 5 prompts below: Prompt 1: Inbox Triage + Drafting “You open Ishita’s inbox and there are 35 unread email s from clients, vendors, and internal team. Walk us through exactly how you would triage it in the first 30 minutes, and draft responses (on screen) to any two email s: - one client email needing an update + reassurance - one vendor email with missing info or a delay Show your folder/label system, what you escalate, and what you close out immediately.” Prompt 2: Chaos ? Plan “Describe a time you walked into a messy situation (unclear owner, shifting priorities, moving pieces). Tell the story in 60–90 seconds, then explain the framework you used to stabilize it: what you clarified first, what you documented, who you aligned, and how you tracked owners + deadlines.” Prompt 3: Design Project Coordination Scenario “Scenario: It’s Tuesday. Ishita has a concept presentation Friday. A vendor says a key lighting option is backordered, the client is asking for ‘one more revision,’ and a contractor needs dimensions for a built-in by end of day. Create a quick ‘command plan’ for the next 48 hours: - priorities ranked (1–5) - who you’ll contact and in what order - Plan A/B/C for the lighting issue - the exact update you’ll send to Ishita (tight bullets) Bonus: show what tool you’d put this in.” Prompt 4: Writing Test (Live) “Live on Loom, draft a short client update email (6–10 sentences) that covers: status, what’s done, what’s next, what you need from them, and the next milestone. Assume the client is anxious—keep it warm, confident, and direct. Then rewrite it as an ‘executive brief’ (bullets, 8 lines max).” Prompt 5: Systems + Follow-Through “Show your personal system for ensuring nothing drops: follow-ups, reminders, tracking decisions, and dependencies. If you can, screen-share a template you’ve created (sanitized). If not, build one live in a doc.” 3) (Optional, but encouraged) A sanitized example of a tracker, SOP, or template you’ve used to run projects or follow-ups (Doc/Notion/Sheet/PDF). Important: We won’t move forward without a Loom. This role lives and dies by communication clarity and follow-through.

title: Medical Virtual Assistant
description: Medical Virtual Assistant Job Description Position Title: Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA) Department: Clinical Operations / Administrative Support Reports To: Practice Manager / Office Administrator Employment Type: Full-time / Part-time (Remote) Schedule: Aligned with practice hours; some flexibility required Position Summary The Medical Virtual Assistant provides remote administrative, billing, and clinical support to a healthcare practice. Working closely with providers and on-site staff, the MVA manages medical billing and coding, patient follow-ups, scheduling, insurance verification, and electronic health record (EHR) documentation. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, HIPAA-compliant, and able to deliver high-quality support that improves patient experience and practice efficiency. Key Responsibilities Medical Billing & Coding • Assign accurate ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS codes to diagnoses, procedures, and services based on provider documentation. • Prepare, review, and submit clean claims to insurance carriers (commercial, Medicare, Medicaid) via clearinghouse or EHR/PM systems. • Post payments, adjustments, and denials; reconcile EOBs and ERAs. • Identify and correct coding errors, missing modifiers, and documentation gaps before claim submission. • Manage accounts receivable (A/R), work aging reports, and follow up on unpaid or denied claims within payer timelines. • File appeals for denied claims with appropriate supporting documentation. • Generate patient statements and respond to billing inquiries with professionalism and clarity. Patient Follow-Ups & Care Coordination • Conduct post-visit follow-up calls to confirm care plan understanding, medication compliance, and symptom changes. • Schedule and confirm follow-up appointments, lab work, imaging, and specialist referrals. • Track outstanding referrals, lab results, and diagnostic reports; escalate abnormal findings to the provider promptly. • Send appointment reminders via phone, text, or patient portal; manage no-show and reschedule workflows. • Coordinate prior authorizations and pre-certifications with insurance companies. • Maintain follow-up logs and ensure all patient outreach is documented in the EHR. Scheduling & Front-Office Support • Manage provider calendars, schedule new and returning patients, and resolve scheduling conflicts. • Verify insurance eligibility and benefits before each visit; collect and document copay information. • Greet inbound calls, triage messages, and route clinical questions to the appropriate staff. • Update patient demographics, insurance details, and pharmacy preferences in the EHR. EHR Documentation & Administrative Support • Assist providers with chart prep, scribing, and clinical note completion as needed. • Process medical records requests, release-of-information forms, and disability or FMLA paperwork. • Maintain organized digital files and ensure documentation meets payer and regulatory standards. • Support telehealth visits with pre-visit setup, technical assistance, and post-visit charting. Compliance & Confidentiality • Maintain strict HIPAA compliance and safeguard all protected health information (PHI). • Follow practice policies, payer guidelines, and applicable federal and state regulations. • Complete required training on HIPAA, OSHA, cybersecurity, and coding updates annually. Required Qualifications • High school diploma or equivalent; associate or bachelor's degree preferred. • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in medical billing, coding, or healthcare administration. • Working knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, and modifiers. • Proficiency with EHR/practice management systems (e.g., Epic, Athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Kareo, DrChrono, NextGen). • Strong written and verbal English communication skills. • Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a HIPAA-compliant computer setup. • Demonstrated ability to handle PHI confidentially and complete HIPAA training. Preferred Qualifications • Certification in medical billing/coding (CPC, CCS, CCA, CBCS, or CMRS). • Experience with insurance verification, prior authorizations, and denial management. • Familiarity with telehealth platforms and patient portals. • Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus. • Prior experience in the practice’s specialty (e.g., primary care, cardiology, dermatology, mental health). Key Skills & Competencies • Attention to Detail — accuracy in coding, claims, and patient records. • Organization — ability to manage multiple workflows, deadlines, and priorities. • Communication — professional, empathetic, and clear with patients, providers, and payers. • Tech-Savvy — comfortable with EHRs, billing software, video conferencing, and productivity tools. • Problem-Solving — proactive in resolving denials, scheduling conflicts, and patient concerns. • Discretion — strict adherence to confidentiality and compliance standards. Performance Metrics • Clean claim rate (target ? 95%). • Days in A/R and percentage of A/R > 90 days. • Denial rate and turnaround time on appeals. • Patient follow-up completion rate and time-to-contact. • Appointment confirmation and no-show reduction rates. • Accuracy of coding audits and documentation reviews. Work Environment This is a fully remote position. The MVA must maintain a dedicated, HIPAA-compliant workspace with secure internet, a working webcam and headset, and the ability to keep PHI inaccessible to others in the household. Schedule will align with the practice’s time zone and patient-facing hours.

title: Amazon Advertising Assistant
description: About us We are a fast-growing, multi-brand Amazon seller with 1,500+ parent SKUs across the US, CA, MX, UK and EU (DE, FR, IT, ES). We’re looking for a talented Amazon Ads Assistant to work closely with our Advertising Manager, taking real ownership of campaigns across our marketplaces to help drive revenue and hit ACOS and TACOS targets. The role Reporting to the Advertising Manager, you will: • Build, manage and optimise Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns across the US, CA, MX, UK and EU marketplaces, including bid management and budget allocation. • Prepare and present weekly and monthly Advertising reports — analysing performance, identifying areas for improvement, and making data-driven recommendations. • Use bulk file uploads and our in-house optimisation software to maintain campaign hygiene and efficiency across a large, complex SKU catalogue. • Launch campaigns for new product launches and existing product refreshes, working to brief from the Advertising Manager. • Monitor and flag performance anomalies proactively — before they become problems. • Critically appraise our existing Advertising processes and bring ideas for improvement. We are always looking to get better. What we're looking for Essential • Minimum 2 years of hands-on Amazon Ads management experience — agency, aggregator, or in-house brand. • Solid understanding of match types, negative targeting, and campaign structure best practices. • Comfortable managing a large, complex catalogue — ideally with experience on brands of 100+ parent SKUs or comparable scale. • Proficient with bulk file uploads in Amazon Ads console and comfortable learning proprietary in-house tooling. • Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day work (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude) to improve efficiency and output quality. • Advanced Excel skills: pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, data formatting for bulk operations. • Strong analytical mindset — able to draw clear, actionable conclusions from campaign and keyword data. • Excellent written and spoken English: able to communicate performance clearly to a non-technical audience. • Highly organised with strong attention to detail and reliable time management. • Self-starter: confident working independently and flagging issues without being prompted. Desirable • Amazon Ads certification (Sponsored Ads). • Familiarity with third-party Advertising tools (e.g. Helium 10 or similar). • Multi-marketplace experience. • Experience presenting Advertising performance to a broader commercial team. What we offer • Competitive salary — 20-25k PHP p/m, depending on experience. • 100% remote — work from anywhere with reliable internet and a meaningful overlap with GMT. • 25 days paid holiday per year. • 13th-month pay. • Paid case study as part of the interview process — we respect your time. • Annual performance review with a structured growth path: Assistant ? Executive ? Manager. • A team built on clear values: accountability, hitting targets, and a genuine growth mindset. A note on seasonality We operate in a highly seasonal business. In return, we operate a time-off-in-lieu policy so any extra hours put in during peak are taken back as additional leave once the season quietens down. Application questions Please answer all seven questions below when you apply. Each question requires a yes or no answer. If your answer to any question is no, this role is not the right fit at this time and we would encourage you not to apply. 1. Do you have a valid passport? (Yes / No) 2. Are you available to work 40 hours per week, with additional hours during peak season (September and October)? (Yes / No) 3. If you answered yes to all of the above, we’d love to hear from you. Please attach your CV and we will be in touch within 5 working days. How to apply Please apply via this job post with your CV and answers to the application questions above. Successful applicants will be invited through the following stages: • 1.  First interview — a 60-minute video call with the Advertising Manager. • 2.  Paid case study — a short, practical task relevant to the role. We will pay for your time. • 3.  Final interview — a 60-minute call with the Advertising Manager and Head of Marketplace. We aim to respond to all applications within 5 working days.

title: Amazon FBA Inventory & Forecasting Manager (Supply Chain + Data Entry) — Long-Term
job_title: Amazon FBA Inventory & Forecasting Manager (Supply Chain + Data Entry) — Long-Term
description: ABOUT US We are a matcha green tea company based in the United States. We sell on Amazon FBA, Walmart, TikTok Shop, and our own Shopify store, and we import our products directly from our manufacturer in Japan. Our entire business depends on one thing above all else: getting the right amount of inventory forecasted, ordered, paid for, and shipped from Japan to Amazon — accurately and on time, every time. Right now that whole process runs through the owner, and we are ready to hand it to an experienced person who can take full ownership of it. This is a long-term, full-time role for someone who wants to grow WITH the company — not a short-term task-taker. As the business grows, this position grows too, with more responsibility and pay increases over time. ---------------------------------------- WHAT THIS ROLE IS REALLY ABOUT We are not just looking for someone to complete assigned tasks. We want someone who takes ownership of this position and actively helps improve and refine our inventory management, forecasting, logistics, and operational processes. The right person thinks proactively, streamlines workflows, improves systems, helps create and refine our standard operating procedures (SOPs), and contributes ideas that make the whole business run more efficiently. You will own the full end-to-end inventory and forecasting process — timing, logistics coordination, and cash flow awareness. There will be periods when the workload is lighter. During those times, we expect you to take initiative — finding ways to improve processes, simplify operations, strengthen our logistics systems, and contribute solutions that help the business overall. ---------------------------------------- WHAT YOU WILL DO INVENTORY FORECASTING (the heart of this role) - Manage our forecasting and inventory planning system (SoStocked) and keep it fully up to date - Forecast monthly product needs accurately — never overbuying, never underbuying - Understand lead times, set up shipments, and manage inventory flow into the United States - Factor in order volume, seasonality, and market demand - Always check your numbers against real Amazon sales data DAILY DATA ENTRY & CASH FLOW TRACKING - Maintain our cash flow management spreadsheet every day - Accurately record purchase orders, product costs, and weekly order data - Keep all inventory and order records clean, organized, and current JAPAN SUPPLIER COORDINATION (real-time operations) - Work during Philippine/Japan business hours so there is always someone actively managing our supplier communication and operations with Japan in real time - Keep a rolling 3-month production schedule visible to our manufacturer at all times - Track the supplier payment schedule and alert the owner ahead of each due date - Organize and file supplier documents (invoices, FDA, USDA) correctly - Communicate in clear, simple English (our supplier translates everything) PROCUREMENT & SUPPLIER SOURCING - Research and identify new suppliers, manufacturers, and packaging partners — including matcha manufacturers in Japan, China, and Taiwan - Contact vendors, request samples, and coordinate packaging production - Make sure materials ship on time, and help manage raw materials stored at supplier warehouses - Example: if we need a new bag manufacturer, you research candidates, reach out, request samples, coordinate shipping, and manage it start to finish FBA SHIPMENTS & CUSTOMS - Create FBA inbound shipments in Amazon Seller Central and send labels to our manufacturer - Monitor every shipment daily once it leaves Japan - If a shipment is held in customs, act immediately — contact the carrier and resolve it CUSTOMER SERVICE & RETURNS (light, about 5-7 tickets/week) - Respond to customer messages across Amazon, email , Shopify chat, Facebook , Instagram, TikTok, and Walmart - Process refunds and reach out to resolve negative reviews - (We have an AI tool to help you draft responses) ---------------------------------------- WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR (required) 1. 2-5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central / FBA operations experience 2. Strong inventory management and forecasting experience — you understand lead times, shipments, and how demand drives forecasting 3. Solid understanding of ecommerce cash flow (you can model it, not just enter it) 4. Experience with FBA inbound shipments 5. Excellent spreadsheet skills and accurate data entry 6. Clear written English 7. A reliable computer and stable, reliable internet connection 8. Willing to join face-to-face video meetings on Zoom or Google Meet with your camera ON, and available for quickly scheduled meetings — both short check-ins and longer working sessions ABOUT OUR SOFTWARE: We use SoStocked as our main forecasting tool. Experience with it is a plus but not required — if you haven't used it, you must be able to learn it quickly and become highly proficient. In your application, tell us which inventory systems you HAVE used. ---------------------------------------- THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE - Detail-oriented and accurate — you take pride in getting the numbers right - Punctual and dependable — you do what you say, on time - Responsive — you reply to messages promptly and keep people updated when you're working on something - A proactive problem solver — you take initiative instead of waiting to be told - An owner — you treat this role like your own business and look for ways to make it better ---------------------------------------- NICE TO HAVE (not required, but a real advantage) - Procurement / supplier sourcing experience (a big plus for this role) - Comfort with AI tools and AI-assisted workflows — we use AI to work faster and more accurately, including to help communicate and translate with our Japanese suppliers - Amazon product listing management experience — we'd love to understand the full range of your Amazon experience, as there may be more responsibilities (and a path to a fuller role) for the right person - QuickBooks experience - TikTok Shop or Walmart Marketplace experience - USDA Organic / NOP experience - Helium ---------- --------------------- HOURS & SCHEDULE - Full-time, 40 hours/week, work from home - You will work during Philippine/Japan daytime hours — this is by design, so our operations with Japan keep moving while our US team is offline - TRAINING NOTE: During your first few weeks of training, you'll work some night hours to train live with the owner (US Central Time). After training, you settle into mostly daytime hours with only occasional evening calls. We want to be upfront so this is a great fit from day one. ---------------------------------------- HOW TO APPLY (please follow carefully) We read every application that follows these steps: SUBJECT LINE: Apply with the subject line — Amazon FBA Inventory Manager — [Your Name] IN YOUR MESSAGE: 1. Start with the exact phrase: I own the numbers. 2. Tell us about the largest Amazon FBA brand you've managed inventory for (monthly revenue or units) and which inventory/forecasting systems you've used. 3. Describe one time you caught a forecasting or shipping problem before it became a stockout — what you saw and what you did. 4. Tell us about your experience sourcing or working with overseas suppliers (Japan, China, Taiwan, or elsewhere), if any. 5. Briefly describe the full range of your Amazon experience and any experience you have using AI tools at work. Applications that do not begin with the phrase above will not be reviewed. We're looking for someone detail-oriented who follows instructions carefully — this is your first chance to show us. We review applications on a rolling basis and reply to strong candidates quickly. We look forward to meeting you. — Pat McLaughlin IV

title: Content Editor (IG) - VA
description: If you've been looking for a long-term role with a fast-growing US brand in the masculine wellness space, read carefully. Joburn and our team has generated over seven million dollars for clients in the past couple of years. We're just getting started. Now we're placing trained operators into the brands we know best — and this is one of those roles. THE BRAND: BEEFCAKE WELLNESS Brandon Bohonko runs Beefcake Wellness. 100,000+ followers across Instagram and TikTok. He gained 70 lbs on purpose to understand what his clients were going through, then started losing it publicly. He documents the whole arc. Posts 5-6 short-form vertical videos per week. The audience is fitness-curious men 25-45 who know what to do and aren't doing it. The brand voice is loose, masculine, lightly profane, period-driven. Lowercase captions. Self-aware. Anti-hype. Think Sam Sulek + Greg Doucette's editing style. Fast cuts, on-screen text that does the work the voice doesn't, music that drives pacing. If you don't already get this register, watch 10 videos ---------- ---------- before applying. WHAT YOU'LL DO Edit 5-6 short-form vertical videos per week (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts) 60-90 seconds per video typically Add cuts, b-roll overlays, on-screen text, music, captions Match Brandon's visual style. You'll get a 20-video reference set plus a style guide. Repurpose long-form podcast or interview footage into 3-5 shorts per session Manage a simple weekly Trello or Notion board of pending vs shipped 48-hour standard turnaround on regular edits, 24-hour on priority You're embedded directly with Brandon's content operation. Not subcontracted. Not white-labeled. You are his editor, daily. REQUIRED 2+ years editing short-form vertical video for social platforms CapCut Pro fluency. Brandon edits rough on iPhone, you finish on desktop. Adobe Premiere Pro OR DaVinci Resolve at an intermediate level Native or near-native English. You'll write on-screen text and clean captions. Stable internet, GMT+8 hours or compatible overlap with Pacific or Mountain time Hook-first editing instinct. The first 1.5 seconds is the entire game. Ability to take a 1-paragraph brief plus raw footage and produce a publishable edit NICE TO HAVE Thumbnail design for YouTube Familiarity with fitness or bodybuilding content Comfortable with profanity and irreverent humor (this IS the brand voice) Loom recording for async feedback exchange WHO WE WANT (AND WHO WE DON'T) We hire on three things. Read these honestly. If they don't sound like you, don't apply. We'd rather you save the time. 1. Radical candor. We tell you when something is off. We expect you to tell us back. No sugar-coating. No "great question!" energy. We just talk. If you need a soft work culture, this isn't it. 2. Extreme ownership. Your edit shipped late? That's on you. The brief was unclear? You should have asked. The team will not hand-hold. The good news: when something works, the credit is also yours. 3. Willingness to move. Speed beats prestige. 10 cuts in 48 hours beats one perfect edit in two weeks. If you need to polish something for a week before shipping, you'll be miserable here. And one more thing. The honest reason we're hiring this way. AI is coming for video editing. Not slowly. We see it. The editors who survive the next 18 months will be the ones who use AI as a leverage tool but keep their own taste on top. The ones who don't will be replaced. We want to help you survive that. This role isn't just an editing job. It's training to become an AI-augmented operator. We pay for the work. The skill upgrade is a side effect of how we work. PAY $3/hr × 40 hrs/wk = $480/mo to start. Rate reviews are based on performance, reliability, and the brand's growth. No specific bumps promised. Strong editors who fit the team can grow with the brand over time. Piece-rate option also on the table for the right person. One last thing before the apply step. Brandon's a fitness guy. He likes seeing what people actually eat. Put your favorite food in the subject line of your reply. Catches the people who read carefully too. HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — this is the only application we review): Reply to this post. We personally watch every reply. In your reply, include: Your portfolio. Links to 5 short-form videos you've edited (Reels, TikToks, Shorts). A 60-second Loom introducing yourself and explaining why this specific brand interests you. One specific video ---------- ---------- you'd improve, and how. We're looking to make this hire within 5 business days. If we move forward with you, we'll be in touch fast. Not looking for a one-project freelancer. Looking for an editor who grows with this brand for 12-24 months minimum. — Cyborg Talent (Joburn) on behalf of Beefcake Wellness
