title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
job_title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description: READ THIS FIRST We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns for Hair Etc., a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California. This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, run a proven script, and book them onto the salon's calendar. If you're a sales-oriented setter who loves high-volume work, runs scripts the way they were written, and is motivated by performance pay tied to real results — keep reading. If you want a low-pressure customer service job or you like "making the script your own," this won't be a fit. IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY. OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses). 13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top. --- ABOUT THE COMPANY You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on Hair Etc., a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years. The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market. You can see the salon directly: - Google Maps Listing: ---------- - Instagram: ---------- You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at Hair Etc. handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked. A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time. We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't. --- WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support. Daily: - Call new Facebook /Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day) - Run our call script word-for-word for the entire call, from greeting to booking. The only time you go off-script is to answer a client's specific question (directions, timing) or collect unique info. - Respond to inbound SMS, Facebook ---------- , and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them - Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel - Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar - Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs - Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM) - Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers Weekly: - One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min) - Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings - Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them During training (first 2–4 weeks): We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence. --- A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY) We say "word-for-word" because that's how the role works — but we want to clear up the most common concern people have about that: "Won't I sound like a robot if I'm reading a script?" No. Think about the best actors in your favorite movies. They're saying lines someone else wrote. They don't sound robotic because they've rehearsed enough that the words feel natural, and they bring real warmth, tone, and presence to the delivery. THAT'S EXACTLY WHAT WE'RE AFTER. The script is the structure. Your tone, pacing, and warmth are what make it feel human. We train for this. You'll rehearse, get coached on tonality and pacing, and review your own call recordings until the words feel like yours — even though they're not. The setters who do this best sound like they're having a natural conversation that just happens to follow a proven path. The script DOES change over time — but only based on data. If something isn't landing in calls, we test a new version, measure the results, and update the script if it works better. What we don't do is let setters freelance individual changes on the fly, because then we can't tell what's working and what's not. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll genuinely consider it. We'll A/B test it together. If the data shows it works better, it becomes the newscript. That's the structured way changes happen here. If that framing works for you, you'll thrive. If "follow a script and let us measure what works" feels suffocating, this role won't be a fit. --- SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES) All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning. - US workdays: Monday through Friday - US days off: Saturday and Sunday - Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call) - Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March): Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT - A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time - A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time - Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night) Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November): - Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT - Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit. Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying. --- COMPENSATION Base pay: $900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month. 13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000. Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly): - $3 per new client showed appointment - $2 per existing client showed appointment - $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon) Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly): - +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month - +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month - +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month Worked examples: Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month: - Base: $950 (midpoint) - Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90) - Threshold bonus: $75 - Total: ~$1,250/month Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month: - Base: $950 - Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120) - Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150) - Total: ~$1,475/month Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked): - Base: $1,000 - Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking) - Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350) - Total: ~$2,025/month This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role. --- OTHER BENEFITS 1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year 2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can. 3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation. To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form --- TARGET KPIs - Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+ - Show Rate: 90%+ - Bookings per day: 4–9 - Showed appointments per month: 100–160 - Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit. --- WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR Background: - Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders. - Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required. Non-negotiable skills: - Advanced English with minimal accent. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier. - Strong spoken communication — clear voice, confident on calls, doesn't ramble, not soft-spoken. - Script discipline. You're comfortable running proven scripts word-for-word in mandatory parts of the call. (See the script section above for context on what this actually means day-to-day.) - Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused. - Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified. - Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising. - Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance. - CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred. - High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one. - Process-oriented. You follow standardized workflows. If you want to change something, you bring a clear, data-backed suggestion to your manager and wait for a decision. - Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing. - Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load. Preferred: - Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry - Personal interest in beauty or self-care - Experience working with older female clientele (35–65) - Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster) Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT): We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean: - Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout. - Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words. - Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat. - Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down. - Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses. - KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them. --- TECH REQUIREMENTS Non-negotiable: - Internet minimum requirements: 25 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire. - Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application. - Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop - Mouse - Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods. - Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls. - Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients. Preferred: - Second monitor - You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster) --- DO NOT APPLY IF: - Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient. - Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker - You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast. - You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure - You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating" - You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it" - You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term - You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation --- HIRING PROCESS 1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions 2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner 3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay 4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion 5. Offer — targeting hires between May 30 – June 7 6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance --- HOW TO APPLY Submit your application through this Tally form: | ---------- | IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience. The form will ask for: - A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar) - A short Loom video introducing yourself - A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net) - A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor) - A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages - A few short questions to gauge fit Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form. --- Looking forward to meeting the right person. Ethan Founder, Midnight Siren --- Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | Pacific Time (Graveyard Shift in PH)

title: Virtual Assistant — Influencer Whitelisting Follow-Up
description: Virtual Assistant — Influencer Whitelisting Follow-Up Part-time · Remote · Ongoing About us We run an influencer marketing agency that partners with e-commerce brands. We connect brands with content creators, and our goal is to get those creators' posts whitelisted — meaning the brand can run paid ads directly through the influencer's Instagram account to drive real traffic and sales. It's a fast-moving operation and we need someone reliable to keep influencers from slipping through the cracks. What you'll be doing Your core job is simple but critical: make sure no influencer goes unanswered. Every day, you'll go through our tracking sheet across 5 brands, identify influencers who are in the whitelisting process but haven't moved forward, look them up in our outreach tool (Instantly), and take the right action based on where things left off. Day to day, that looks like: - Reviewing a Google Sheet daily across multiple brands - Looking up influencers in Instantly to read email threads and understand where we left off - Sending follow-up email s using provided scripts and adapting them to context - Responding to influencer replies that our inbox manager missed - Updating the tracking sheet as you work so the rest of the team stays in sync - Notifying the client via Slack when a whitelisting request is ready to be sent What we're looking for Experienced with email management and follow-ups. You've handled outreach or follow-up sequences before and understand how to read a thread, pick up mid-conversation, and write a reply that feels natural — not templated. Self-sufficient. You don't need someone checking in on you every day. You log on, do your work, flag anything unusual, and move on. You know how to handle standard situations without asking for hand-holding. A strong communicator. Your written English is clear, professional, and warm. You can adapt the tone of a message based on the situation — whether that's a gentle nudge, a more assertive follow-up, or responding to pushback. Detail-oriented. You catch things others miss. Updating the right column, using the right persona name for the right brand, reading the email thread before replying — these things matter to you. A team player. You'll be working alongside other VAs who have overlapping responsibilities. You understand your lane, communicate clearly when something's outside it, and help the team stay in sync rather than creating confusion. Comfortable with basic tools. Google Sheets, Slack, email platforms. We'll train you on our specific tools (Instantly), but you should be someone who picks up new software quickly. Nice to have - Experience with influencer marketing, content creator outreach, or social media - Familiarity with email outreach platforms (Instantly, Lemlist, Smartlead, or similar) - Experience working across multiple clients or brands simultaneously What to expect - Part-time, fully remote, flexible hours - You'll be given a clear SOP and scripts — no guesswork on what to say - You'll be part of a small, tight team with clear roles - Opportunity to grow your role as the agency scales How to apply If this sounds like a good fit, send us a message telling us: - A bit about your background in email management or follow-up work - Any tools you've used for outreach or CRM-style tracking - Why you think you'd be a good fit for this specific role Important — read carefully before applying: To be considered, your subject line must be exactly: INFLUXX WHITELISTING VA Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed. This is a small test of whether you read and follow instructions — a key part of this job.

title: Legal Operations Coordinator
description: We are a fast-growing legal support company based in Northern California. Our team runs on tight workflows, real-time systems, and a strong culture of follow-through. This is an operational business — accuracy and reliability are everything. As a Legal Operations Coordinator, you will be embedded in our daily operations: managing our CRM, handling client communications, preparing proofs of service, coordinating with field contractors, and keeping our internal workflows on track. You will not be given vague tasks. You will be given systems, SOPs, and clear responsibilities. Your job is to execute them accurately and consistently, flag issues proactively, and help keep the operation running without gaps or dropped follow-ups. What You Will Do Day-to-Day CRM & Case Management Update and maintain case records in our custom CRM after each action Enter new client orders accurately with all required fields Track case status and flag anything overdue or stalled Ensure data integrity across all active cases Client Communication Send status updates to clients when cases are assigned, completed, or delayed Respond to inbound client email s within defined response time windows Follow up on pending client approvals, missing information, or overdue payments Maintain a professional, clear tone in all written communication Proof & Document Preparation Prepare and format proofs of service from completed job reports Organize and file completed documents in the correct folder structure Verify that proofs match the underlying case details before delivery Track proof status and follow up with contractors when documentation is missing Contractor Coordination Assign incoming service requests to available field contractors Send job details and confirm acceptance Follow up on jobs that have not been updated or completed on time Assist with payroll verification by confirming completed jobs against contractor reports Operational Reporting & Task Tracking Maintain daily task logs and end-of-day status summaries Track open items and ensure nothing slips through the cracks Flag operational issues or patterns to the operations manager Support internal process improvements as they are rolled out What This Role Is Not This role does not involve sales, cold outreach, social media management, graphic design, or generic administrative work. If you are looking for a varied creative role or a light-touch assistant position, this is not the right fit. This role is high-volume, detail-intensive, and process-driven. The same types of tasks repeat daily. Excellence here means executing those tasks accurately and on time, every time. Requirements Must Have Excellent written English — clear, professional, and grammatically correct Strong organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple open tasks Extreme attention to detail — errors in legal documents have real consequences Ability to follow SOPs and workflows without needing constant supervision Reliable internet connection (please include your speed in your application) Comfortable learning new software systems quickly Consistent availability during agreed working hours Nice to Have Prior experience with a CRM system (any platform) Background in legal support, paralegal work, or legal administration Experience in dispatch, logistics coordination, or operational admin Familiarity with Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets) Tools We Use Training is provided on all tools. Custom CRM (proprietary, training provided) Google Workspace — Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets Slack — internal team communication Twilio — SMS-based client and contractor communication AI-assisted workflow tools Compensation & Growth $5–$7/hour based on experience Performance bonuses available after the training period Part-time initially (20–30 hrs/week) with the potential to grow Clear growth path into an operations management position for the right person How to Apply Send your application to ---------- include: A brief introduction — who you are and what you do A summary of your experience with operations, admin, or coordination work One or two specific examples of organizational tasks you have managed Your internet speed (upload and download) Your availability and time zone The word "Northbound" somewhere in your application so we know you read this carefully Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed. title: Executive Assistant
description: # Executive & Personal Assistant to Founder I’m hiring a personal executive assistant to work directly with me and help run the practical parts of my life. This is a high-trust role. I’m looking for someone who can handle my schedule, travel, appointments, vendors, errands, reservations, events, follow-ups, and the many small things that otherwise sit in my head. The right person is organized, discreet, loyal, fast, calm, and hard to fluster. You should have good taste, strong judgment, and the ability to figure things out without needing every step explained. This is not a normal admin job. You will be close to how I operate day to day. You will see personal details, private conversations, family logistics, business matters, and sensitive information. Discretion is required. ## What you’ll handle You will help with both personal and professional logistics, including: * Managing my calendar and daily schedule * Coordinating travel, transportation, hotels, restaurants, and itineraries * Booking appointments, reservations, dinners, events, and experiences * Handling errands, purchases, returns, gifting, and personal tasks * Managing household vendors, service providers, and recurring logistics * Keeping track of follow-ups, reminders, deadlines, and open loops * Preparing me for meetings, calls, trips, and events * Communicating with people on my behalf when needed * Creating simple systems so things do not fall through the cracks * Taking on special projects as they come up Some days will be structured. Some days will change quickly. I need someone who can adapt without getting thrown off. ## What I’m looking for I’m looking for someone who takes pride in being excellent at the details. You should be the kind of person who notices when something is slightly off, follows up without being chased, and thinks two steps ahead. You should be comfortable making judgment calls, but also know when something needs to be escalated. Strong candidates will be: * Very organized * Discreet * Loyal * Calm under pressure * Fast to respond * Good at written communication * Comfortable around high-performing people * Comfortable with personal tasks * Good with vendors, hospitality, scheduling, and logistics * Detail-oriented without being rigid * Resourceful when the answer is not obvious You do not need to have done this exact role before, but you do need to have high standards. ## This role is probably not for you if * You need a predictable 9-to-5 environment * You dislike personal errands or lifestyle-related work * You need every task fully documented before starting * You are uncomfortable with confidentiality * You get overwhelmed when plans change * You are casual about follow-through * You think “assistant” means waiting to be told what to do ## Compensation and long-term upside I want this to be a long-term role. For the right person, compensation will increase meaningfully over time with trust, loyalty, responsibility, and performance. The more useful and dependable you become, the more the role can grow. I believe in taking care of people who take care of me. If you become someone I can rely on completely, there is no fixed ceiling on where this can go. This is a role for someone who wants to build real trust over years, not months. ## Ideal background Helpful experience may include: * Personal assistant work * Executive assistant work * Hospitality * Private client service * Family office support * Founder or entrepreneur support * Event planning * Travel coordination * Household management * Operations-heavy roles The most important qualities are judgment, loyalty, discretion, speed, and taste. ## How to apply Please send: * A short note about yourself * Relevant experience * Where you are based * Your availability * A few examples of situations where you had to organize something complex, handle a sensitive matter, or solve a problem without much direction I care more about quality, trust, and reliability than a perfect resume.

Your job is to help us find the right people, organize leads, send approved outreach, track responses, and flag warm opportunities. ## Responsibilities You will help with: * Researching potential private event clients, venue partners, sponsors, and community partners * Finding decision-makers such as HR managers, event managers, office managers, university program coordinators, nonprofit leaders, venue managers, and partnership contacts * Finding contact information, websites, LinkedIn profiles, and email s * Organizing leads in a Google Sheet or CRM * Categorizing leads by type, priority, and fit * Sending approved first-touch outreach email s * Sending approved follow-up email s * Tracking responses and next follow-up dates * Flagging warm replies or strong opportunities for the founder * Creating weekly pipeline reports ## Types of Leads You’ll Research You will help us find contacts in categories like: * Corporate HR / employee engagement * Team-building buyers * University departments and student life teams * Nonprofits and arts organizations * Apartment communities * Event venues * Breweries, bars, hotels, galleries, and cultural spaces * Local sponsors and community partners * Young professional groups and associations ## Required Skills You should be: * Very organized * Good at online research * Comfortable using Google Sheets * Able to follow detailed instructions * Able to write clearly in English * Comfortable finding email s and LinkedIn profiles * Detail-oriented with clean data entry * Reliable with deadlines * Comfortable sending professional outreach email s from approved templates * Able to track follow-ups without being reminded ## Nice to Have Not required, but helpful: * Experience with lead generation * Experience with CRM tools * Experience with email outreach * Experience using LinkedIn for research * Experience with Apollo, Hunter, RocketReach, or similar tools * Experience researching U.S.-based contacts or companies * Interest in events, startups, community, hospitality, arts, or entertainment ## Important: Please Show Relevant Work We are not looking for a general virtual assistant who only says they are “hardworking” or “detail-oriented.” We are looking for someone who can show proof of relevant experience. Strong applicants will be able to show examples of: * Lead lists they have built * CRM or pipeline trackers they have managed * Outreach campaigns they have supported * Contact research they have completed * Follow-up systems they have maintained * Reports or summaries they have created for a client or employer You do not need to share confidential information. title: Dispatch Operations Specialist
description: AJG Transport (GH Logistics Affiliate) is a US based asset carrier operating 150+ company trucks on dedicated government contract freight. We run 365 days a year on consistent, contracted routes across 48 states. We're scaling fast with new markets, new lanes, new teams, and we need operators who can keep up. This isn't a BPO. This isn't a call center. You'll be embedded in a real U.S. logistics operation working alongside American dispatchers, drivers, and carriers on live freight. Role Overview You're an operator working directly alongside our dispatch and freight management team, handling the higher complexity operational work that keeps our network running. Think of this as the role that handles what most people can't, the exceptions, the escalations, the details that make or break a load. What You’ll Be Doing • Book and coordinate loads across our network while ensuring proper carrier coverage, profitability, and operational efficiency. You own the load from booking through final delivery. • Monitor and manage active loads across our network. Tracking, status updates, carrier and driver communication, and exception handling. You own the load from pickup to delivery. • Verify data accuracy, documentation completeness, and process compliance across active loads. Catch problems before they become expensive. • Conduct check calls, appointment scheduling, detention tracking, rate confirmations. You're the voice on the phone making sure freight moves on time. • Respond to driver inquiries, route them to the right internal team, document issues. Drivers call with problems and you solve them or escalate them fast. • Ensure accurate data on TMS for Loads, rates, stops, and documents. Everything in our systems needs to be accurate. You're the last line of defense before bad data creates bad decisions. • Identify recurring issues, flag inefficiencies, and recommend fixes. We don't want someone who just follows a checklist. We want someone who makes the checklist better. • Report daily and weekly ops summaries for US leadership. • Know what you can solve vs. what needs to go up the chain, and route it fast. No sitting on problems. Who We’re Looking For • 2+ years experience in freight brokerage, dispatch, or logistics operations. NOT GENERAL VA WORK. We need someone who already knows what a BOL is, what detention means, and how a load moves from quote to delivery. • Hands on experience with TMS platforms such as McLeod, Aljex, Turvo, or similar. If you've dispatched loads in a real system, we want to talk to you. • Familiarity with load boards such as DAT, Truckstop, Highway or similar. You've sourced carriers or managed freight on these platforms before. • Strong written and verbal English. You'll be on calls and email with US based drivers, carriers, and leadership daily. This is non negotiable. • Night shift in PH availability — You'll work U.S. business hours. CST timezone alignment preferred (example: 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST/CDT = 8:00 PM – 6:00 AM PHT). • Self-directed. You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the problem, you fix it, you report it. If you need someone holding your hand, this isn't the role. Schedule & Work Setup • Full time permanent remote role • Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO) • Current needed shifts: 7 AM – 5 PM CDT | 3 PM - 1 AM CDT | 11 PM - 9 AM CDT (San Antonio time) • Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations • Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift) • Possible Hubstaff time tracking during shifts, but is not currently in use. What You'll Get • $7/hr USD. Paid consistently biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses. • Independent Contractor Setup • $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire) • Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us. • Growth path. 90 day performance review with opportunity to advance into senior operations roles as we scale. We're growing fast and the people who prove themselves early get the best opportunities. • Direct access to U.S. executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager in Manila. You work directly with our operations team in Texas and Tennessee. • Real operations work. Live freight, real drivers, real carriers, real money on the line. This isn't data entry with a fancy title. Who Thrives Here • People who've worked in a U.S. freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable • Former dispatchers or carrier reps who are tired of BPO environments • Operators who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You run your loads like they are your business. • People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in. Who This Isn't For • General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks. • People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task • Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently • Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics. How to Apply: ---------- Training Overview Video: ---------- /share/fd6816fb8d664dcdbd ---------- b646edb?sid=6fbbf39d-c99f-4583-a6d1-6aa664bd22f7

title: Operations Procurement Coordinator
description: Operations Procurement Coordinator (Remote) We are a growing international food manufacturing business with operations across Vanuatu and Australia, currently focused on strengthening procurement coordination, operational support systems, supplier management, and supply chain visibility during a period of growth and operational scale-up. We are looking for a highly organised and operationally minded Procurement Coordinator to help support the day-to-day purchasing and operational supply requirements of our Vanuatu manufacturing operation remotely. This is a hands-on operational coordination role focused on keeping things moving, supporting operational continuity, improving follow-through, and helping build more consistent and scalable procurement systems and workflows across the business. The role is heavily focused on supplier coordination, freight and shipping follow-up, purchasing support, workflow visibility, operational prioritisation, and practical day-to-day execution rather than purely strategic or corporate procurement activity. Key Focus Areas * Coordinating operational purchasing requirements across packaging, consumables, spare parts, PPE, services, and general operational supplies * Managing supplier communication, follow-up, and order coordination * Supporting freight, shipping, import/export, and logistics coordination for Vanuatu operations * Tracking ETAs, supply risks, urgent operational requirements, and critical stock items * Supporting operational continuity through proactive communication and follow-through * Coordinating closely with operations, warehouse/logistics, finance, production, and suppliers across multiple locations and time zones * Assisting with procurement records, documentation, PO tracking, spend visibility, and traceability requirements * Supporting procurement workflow consistency, process improvement, and practical systems development within a growing SME/startup environment * Providing timely updates, escalating issues early, and helping maintain visibility across operational purchasing activities Ideal Experience * Procurement, purchasing, supply coordination, logistics, or operational support experience * Previous experience supporting manufacturing, FMCG, food production, industrial operations, logistics, or other operationally intensive environments is considered essential due to the pace, operational coordination requirements, and manufacturing continuity responsibilities involved * Experience coordinating suppliers, freight providers, and operational purchasing activities * Experience coordinating packaging, consumables, spare parts, PPE, maintenance-related items, and operational services highly regarded * Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple moving priorities * Strong communication and follow-through * Comfortable working remotely with operational teams across locations and time zones * Experience using procurement, ERP, inventory, or operational systems (Netsuite, SAP, Batchmaster, MYOB, etc.) advantageous * Strong Excel/Google Sheets capability preferred * Comfortable working within evolving systems and fast-paced operational environments ### Ideal Person We are looking for someone who is: * Practical and operationally focused * Highly organised and responsive * Strong with follow-through and communication * Comfortable bringing structure to ambiguity * Able to balance urgency, operational continuity, and cost awareness * Calm under pressure and solutions-focused * Comfortable working independently while supporting a fast-moving operational team remotely Additional Notes This role supports a Vanuatu-based manufacturing operation remotely and requires strong coordination, communication, responsiveness, and operational prioritisation across suppliers, freight providers, and internal teams. The role requires regular daily coordination with Australian suppliers, freight providers, and the Vanuatu operations team. Candidates must therefore be comfortable communicating via phone, email , and video calls and working primarily within Australian and Vanuatu business hours. We are ideally looking for someone available to commence within the next 1–2 weeks, as our current Procurement Officer finishes on June 12 and we are focused on maintaining operational continuity during the transition. We are open to: * Full-time or part-time arrangements * Project-based or ongoing support * Remote engagement * Potential future growth depending on business needs and long-term structure Compensation USD $12–15/hour depending on experience, manufacturing/procurement background, and overall capability.

title: Travel, Procurement & Fleet Coordinator
description: Who is Bare? Bare is the new way to funeral. We are a holistic end of life care provider, allowing our families to grieve in their own way, at their own pace, knowing their loved one is cared for by a team who truly understand their needs. By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalized and affordable. In only five years, we’ve served more than 30,000 families, have become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (with awards in customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and have built a team of more than 100 people committed to changing the way Australians deal with end-of-life. And we’re just getting started. Position Overview We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Travel, Procurement & Fleet Coordinator to manage operations for our Australian business. This multi-faceted role is critical to maintaining seamless daily logistics. You will be responsible for orchestrating domestic and corporate travel, managing supplier procurement in line with local compliance, and assisting with the maintenance and safety of our corporate fleet. The ideal candidate understands the Australian vendor landscape, has experience managing corporate travel across ANZ, and brings a strong customer-service focus to supporting our local workforce. Key Responsibilities 1. Travel Management (Approx. 40%) Booking & Domestic Logistics: Coordinate extensive corporate travel bookings across Australia (interstate) including flights (Qantas, Virgin Australia, Jetstar), corporate accommodation, and car rentals. Policy Compliance: Enforce the company’s travel and expense policy, ensuring cost-efficient booking habits and appropriate tier selections. TMC & Platform Management: Act as the primary administrator for the corporate travel management platform (e.g., Corporate Traveller, FCM, or Serko) and handle corporate profile updates. Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) & Expense Alignment: Support the Finance team by ensuring travel expenses are accurately categorized to assist with FBT reporting and tracking meals/entertainment allowances. 2. Procurement & Supplier Relations (Approx. 40%) Local Sourcing: Raise purchase requisitions and manage the end-to-end purchase order (PO) process for Australian suppliers, covering office supplies, IT equipment, and operational materials. Vendor Management: Onboard new vendors, track supplier performance, and maintain compliant records including valid Australian Business Numbers (ABNs) and GST status verification. Payment Lifecycle Collaboration: Reconcile invoices against delivery receipts and POs, liaising closely with the Accounts Payable team to ensure adherence to agreed payment terms. Modern Slavery Act Compliance: Assist the procurement team in verifying supplier compliance in alignment with corporate social responsibility guidelines and local Modern Slavery reporting frameworks. 3. Fleet Management Assistance (Approx. 20%) Asset Tracking & Registration: Maintain an updated corporate fleet registry, ensuring all vehicle registrations (via relevant state bodies like VicRoads, Transport for NSW, TMR, etc.) and compulsory third-party (CTP) insurances are systematically renewed. Maintenance & Safety: Coordinate scheduled logbook servicing, tyre replacements, and vehicle inspections to maintain fleet safety and uphold manufacturer warranties. Fuel Cards & Linkt/E-Toll Management: Monitor corporate fuel card accounts (e.g., Ampol, BP, Shell) and toll account usage (e.g., Linkt), reporting on weekly or monthly variances. I ---------- Management: Assist drivers with a ---------- reporting processes, insurance claims documentation, and coordinating roadside assistance when required. Qualifications & Skills Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an operations, procurement, or corporate travel coordination role within Australia. Previous exposure to vehicle fleet coordination or logistics is highly regarded. Technical Systems: Proficiency with ERP/financial software (e.g., Xero, MYOB, SAP, NetSuite), expense management tools, and corporate travel software (e.g., Velocity, Concur). Regulatory Understanding: Familiarity with Australian business operational requirements, including GST invoicing principles, state-based vehicle registration rules, and basic workplace safety requirements. Communication & Negotiation: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to handling internal staff requests and local vendor negotiations. Problem-Solving: Strong situational awareness with the ability to resolve rapid shifts in logistics, such as travel disruptions or freight delays. What We Offer Competitive salary package. Collaborative team environment with hybrid working flexibility. Clear pathways for professional growth and career progression across the operations and procurement functions. Please include a link to your resume for review.

title: Appointment Setter (High Volume)
description: ABOUT US We are a family-owned hair salon based in Southern California that has been operating for over 20 years. Our specialty is color and highlight services, and our clients are primarily women aged 35 to 65 who come back to us for years. Over the past year, we've built out a Meta ads funnel using GoHighLevel as our CRM and phone system, and we're now generating a steady flow of inbound leads from Facebook and Instagram. I'm hiring one full-time appointment setter to handle all of those leads and book them into the salon. This is a long-term role. I'm looking for someone who wants to stay with us for at least a year and grow into the position. WHAT YOU'LL DO You will be the only person responsible for converting our inbound leads into booked appointments. - Work inbound leads from our Meta ads through call, SMS, and DM (Facebook and Instagram) inside GoHighLevel - Run our booking script as written: discovery questions, offer presentation, and the card-on-file close - Handle objections using the framework I will train you on (reframe value, build trust, induce gentle urgency without being pushy) - Send Stripe payment links to capture the card on file, then book the appointment in our calendar - Charge the card on file in Stripe for any late cancels or no-shows (a few minutes per day) - Log every interaction cleanly in the CRM so I can review conversion data and refine the script over time The most important ---------- nt on every call is getting the card on file. Once we have it, our show rate jumps from around 55% to 90%, so that is the part of the script that matters most. KPI TARGETS This is a high-volume, metrics-driven role. You will know exactly how you are performing every day. - Calls per day: 150 to 250 - Leads worked per day: 17 to 25 - Lead-to-booking rate: 25% or higher - Show rate: 90% or higher (after card on file) - Bookings per day: 4 to 9 - Showed appointments per month: 100 to 160 WHAT I NEED YOU TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING Script adherence is a dealbreaker. We need you to follow the script word for word on the key parts of every call. We use conversion data to test what's working and what isn't, and if everyone is freestyling their own version, the data is useless. If you have ideas to improve the script, we genuinely want to hear them, but you raise them with as feedback, not by changing things on calls. The schedule is fixed. Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time. For someone in the Philippines, that is 11:45 PM to 8:45 AM PHT (an overnight shift). No exceptions, no shift swaps, no occasional late starts. I need someone who has actually worked overnight shifts before and knows they can sustain it for at least 12 months. Tech reliability is non-negotiable. The role does not work if your internet drops two or three times a week. I will ask about your backup plan (mobile hotspot or second ISP), and we will test your connection and audio live from your actual work setup before any offer. REQUIREMENTS - 6 to 12 months of phone-based sales, appointment setting, or BPO experience (4+ hours per day on the phone) - Clear, neutral English with strong listening skills (you'll be talking to US-based women aged 35 to 65 all day) - Comfortable with high call volume (150 to 250 dials per day) and a long-term commitment to that pace - Strong script discipline and comfort operating inside a defined process - Reliable home office setup: 8GB RAM minimum (16GB preferred), wired headset with boom mic, computer mouse, internet at 25 to 50 Mbps down and 10 to 20 Mbps up, ping under 50ms, and a real backup internet plan you have actually used - Available Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time (overnight in the Philippines) NICE TO HAVE - Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (CRM and phone) - Experience with Stripe payment links - Background in B2C inbound sales (beauty, wellness, fitness, medspa, or salon) - Personal interest in beauty, hair, or self-care COMPENSATION - Base: $900 USD per month - Performance bonuses: $3 per new client show, $2 per existing client show, $1 per rebooking show - Monthly threshold bonuses (cumulative): +$75 at 90 shows, +$150 at 120 shows, +$350 at 150 shows - On-target earnings: approximately $1,300 to $1,815 per month - PTO: 14 days per year after a 90-day probation period - Payment: Paid through ---------- on a regular schedule - Equipment: I will buy you a headset if you need one. Computer and internet are yours. To be straightforward about the structure: roughly 30 to 50% of your monthly income will come from performance bonuses. If you want a high guaranteed base with low expectations, this isn't the right fit. If you want a clear path to earn more by actually performing, the math works well here. HOW TO APPLY Submit a link to your updated resume and Please send me a a cover letter explaining: 1. Your most relevant phone-based sales or appointment setting experience (how long, what industry, what volume) 2. Your history with overnight shifts and how long you sustained that schedule 3. Your home internet speeds (down/up) and your backup plan 4. Whether you can commit to the Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM PST schedule for at least 12 months

When our team is off the clock, maintenance issues don't stop — and some of them genuinely can't wait until morning. We're looking for a reliable, calm, and sharp-thinking coordinator to be the first point of contact for after-hours maintenance calls and messages.  Your most important job is knowing the difference between a real emergency and something that can wait — and acting accordingly. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Answer or respond to inbound maintenance requests via phone, voi cemail , text, or email during off-hours - Triage each request: determine whether it is a true emergency requiring immediate escalation, or a routine issue to be logged and scheduled - Contact and wake up the on-call manager only when the situation genuinely warrants it (fire, flooding, gas leak, security breach, etc.) - Log all requests accurately in our system with time, description, urgency level, and action taken - Communicate clearly and professionally with tenants and vendors - Follow our escalation protocols — we will train you on these - Monitor property security cameras during your shift and flag anything suspicious - Contact local police or emergency services when a situation on camera warrants it - Fill downtime with assigned ad-hoc administrative tasks — data entry, document organization, research, scheduling support, or other work as needed. This is not a sit-and-wait role. EMERGENCY vs NON-EMERGENCY  — WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You should be able to recognize that these are emergencies: - Active fire, flooding, or structural damage - Gas leak or carbon monoxide - Broken exterior door or lock (security risk) - No heat in winter or no AC in extreme heat (depending on situation) - Medical or safety situation on property And these are not emergencies: - Appliance not working (dishwasher, dryer, etc.) - Minor plumbing issues that aren't causing damage - Noise complaints - Requests that can be scheduled during business hours - We're not expecting perfection on day one — we'll provide training and a reference guide.  We are expecting good judgment and the ability to stay calm under pressure. REQUIREMENTS - Excellent written and spoken English - Call Center experience - Reliable internet connection and a quiet work environment - Comfortable using basic computer tools: email , Google Sheets or similar, messaging apps - Able to work US evening/night/weekend hours consistently - Responsive — if you're on shift, you're reachable PREFERRED - Prior experience in property management, customer service dispatch, or a call center handling urgent requests - Familiarity with US rental or real estate operations - Experience using property management software (AppFolio, Buildium, Rent Manager, etc.) — not required, trainable WHAT WE OFFER - Consistent part-time hours with potential to grow - Clear protocols and training — you won't be guessing - Direct communication with a small, responsive team - Long-term relationship if it's a good fit TO APPLY PLEASE SEND A SHORT MESSAGE EXPLAINING: - Why you're a good fit for this role - Any relevant experience handling urgent or time-sensitive situations - Your availability (days/hours in Philippine time) Applications without a personal message will not be considered.

title: Full Time Dispatcher
description: About the Role We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Dispatcher with a positive attitude and excellent communication skills. The ideal candidate will have expertise in load negotiation, scheduling, and route planning, while adhering to DOT and ELD regulations. Vehicles Being Dispatched 26-Foot Box Trucks (10,000 lb weight capacity) – Dock-high with lift gate Sprinter Vans / Cargo Vans / Ram ProMaster (High Roof) About Us Eveready Express is a well-established leader in the trucking, courier, logistics, and distribution industries, founded in 1984. We pride ourselves on honesty, integrity, and mutual respect. Key Responsibilities Dispatching Vehicles Negotiate rates with drivers while aiming for a minimum 40% margin, and assign vehicles to specific routes and deliveries based on customer orders, schedules, and driver availability. Communication with Drivers Maintain constant communication with drivers by providing instructions, updates, and support throughout their routes. Routing and Scheduling Plan efficient routes to minimize travel time, fuel costs, and vehicle wear. Adjust schedules as needed to accommodate changes or unexpected events. Tracking Shipments Monitor shipments in real time using tracking systems and GPS technology. Address delays or issues as they arise. Customer Interaction Serve as the primary point of contact for customers after dispatch, providing delivery updates, addressing inquiries, and resolving concerns or complaints promptly. Documentation Maintain accurate records of trucking activities, including driver logs, delivery schedules, and customer communications. Ensure compliance with company policies and regulations (e.g., BOL, POD). Problem-Solving Resolve logistical problems or emergencies such as vehicle breakdowns, traffic delays, or adverse weather conditions. Safety Compliance Ensure trucks and drivers comply with safety regulations and company policies. Regularly verify driver credentials, vehicle maintenance, and adherence to transportation laws in collaboration with HR. Team Collaboration Work closely with Customer Service, Fleet Drivers, Billing, Sales, HR, and Warehouse staff to coordinate operations and improve efficiency. Continuous Improvement Identify and suggest improvements to dispatching processes, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency. Offer feedback and innovative solutions to the management team. Working on Load Boards Bid on Sylectus, DAT, Amazon Relay, and other broker platforms during the off-peak season. Qualifications • At least 2 years of experience in the U.S. logistics industry, with proven experience in dispatching, logistics coordination, or transportation management. • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with drivers, customers, and tea ---------- mbers. • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment. • Proficiency in dispatching software, GPS systems, and other relevant technology tools. • Knowledge of transportation regulations, safety procedures, and industry best practices. • Ability to remain calm under pressure, with a problem-solving mindset and flexibility to adapt to changing circumstances. • Availability to work irregular hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, to ensure 24/7 coverage. Hardware & Technical Requirements • Processor: 2.0 GHz or higher (Intel Core i5/i7 preferred) • RAM: Minimum 8 GB • Disk Space: 100 GB of free space • A second monitor for multitasking • Backup computer • Noise-canceling headset • Internet: Minimum 20 Mbps wired connection for both primary and backup ISPs • USB sticks are not allowed for backup ISP connections Perks of the Job • Competitive weekly salary • Opportunity to receive HMO benefits • Opportunities for advancement within the company To Apply Please send an email with the subject line: “I want to dispatch for Eveready” to ---------- Your email must include: • A voice recording (via Speakpipe or Vocaroo) explaining why you are a good fit for the role • A PDF copy of your resume • A photo of your workstation • A screenshot of your internet speed test from speedtest.net Please follow all instructions above. Only applicants who demonstrate genuine interest in the role will be considered. If selected, you will be invited to a brief Skype or Google Meet interview, which will require a video call. description: Coordinate 3-5 contractors (scaling to 10-15) building AI-powered business systems across multiple concurrent projects. You'll translate technical specs into executed code, manage dependencies, and maintain quality standards. Remote, full-time (40 hours/week), Philippines-based, EST overlap required (4-6 hours daily). **CRITICAL REQUIREMENT:** You must be comfortable using AI coding assistants (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, Cody, GitHub Copilot, etc.) to build production features daily. **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** Contractor Coordination (40%): - Break complex specs into contractor assignments - Track deliverables across multiple concurrent projects - Prevent duplicate work and dependency conflicts - Conduct code reviews against specifications - GitHub/GitLab workflows and PR reviews - Comfortable working independently with weekly check-ins - Willing to push back when specs are unclear or timelines unrealistic **DIRECT COMMUNICATION REQUIRED:** We need someone who will tell us when specs are incomplete, flag issues early, challenge decisions that create technical problems, and say "this won't work" instead of silently struggling. **WORKING WITH THE FOUNDER:** 1. Founder writes comprehensive component specs 2. You break specs into contractor assignments 3. Contractors execute using AI-assisted development 4. You conduct technical validation and code review 5. You provide acceptance recommendations 6. Founder makes business decisions based on your assessment You maintain the component control system, track dependencies, conduct code reviews, handle tactical execution. **THIS ROLE ISN'T FOR YOU IF:** - You're not comfortable learning and using AI coding tools daily - You need daily standups instead of async coordination - You prefer single-project focus over managing multiple systems - You avoid telling leadership when they're wrong **TO APPLY, INCLUDE:** 1. B) Contractor delivers working code that doesn't match architectural patterns. How do you handle it? C) Two contractors independently created similar database tables with different schemas. How do you resolve it? D) Founder asks for a timeline you know is impossible. What do you say and how? 4. Logistics: Your timezone, EST overlap availability, start date, current hourly rate expectations ($7-10 range) **WAGE/SALARY PER MONTH:** $7-10/hour USD ($1,120-1,600/month for 40 hours/week) based on experience and AI tool proficiency. title: Executive Search Recruiter & Research Analyst
description: About Crimson Jay Executive Search Partners **Experience in an executive search agency setting or similar is required for this role. Crimson Jay solely focuses on C-level Executive Search within the USA. Previous experience recruiting for C-level and/or VP level positions is an absolute requirement.** Crimson Jay Executive Search Partners is a retained executive search firm that partners with founder-led and investor-backed companies to recruit transformational financial and operational leaders. We specialize in placing CFOs, COOs, and senior executives who drive scalable growth, build infrastructure, and position businesses for successful exits. Our clients are typically high-growth companies ranging from $1M to $200M in revenue across B2B services, SaaS, manufacturing, and financial services. Our work is highly strategic, often tied directly to value creation initiatives and investment outcomes. We operate with a structured, outcome-driven process focused on deep upfront alignment, disciplined candidate evaluation, and high-quality execution. This is not high-volume recruiting, this is precision search. Role Overview This role is not just research and coordination, it is a critical front-end gatekeeper of candidate quality. The Executive Search Research Analyst & Candidate Screening Associate will be responsible for identifying, evaluating, and qualifying executive talent before candidates ever reach the Founder. This includes assessing whether candidates are true “drivers” of scale versus those who have operated within already successful environments. You will play a central role in shaping candidate pipelines, improving signal-to-noise ratio, and ensuring that only high-caliber, well-aligned candidates move forward in the process. This is a high-responsibility role with direct impact on search outcomes. Key Responsibilities Candidate Sourcing & Market Research • Build highly targeted candidate pipelines using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and market mapping • Develop company target lists, org charts, and competitive landscapes aligned to each search • Track executive movement, private equity activity, and industry trends to identify relevant talent • Continuously refine sourcing strategies to improve candidate quality, not just volume Candidate Screening & Qualification (Core Focus) • Conduct initial candidate screening calls to assess: • Ability to drive scalability versus operate within existing success • Experience building infrastructure, KPIs, and operating cadence • Alignment with investor-backed environments and value creation goals • Career trajectory and job transition patterns over the past 10–15 years • Evaluate candidates against defined measurable outcomes for each role • Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or risks early in the process • Prepare concise, high-signal candidate summaries with clear recommendations • Act as a quality filter to ensure only strong, well-vetted candidates move forward Search Execution Support • Maintain and manage candidate pipelines within Loxo ATS with precision and consistency • Assist in building candidate scorecards, interview materials, and client deliverables • Coordinate interviews and ensure a smooth, professional candidate experience • Support reference check coordination and candidate communication throughout the process Administrative & Operational Support • Provide light executive support including scheduling and coordination • Format and prepare client-facing documents such as job profiles and candidate presentations • Track search progress, timelines, and deliverables across active engagements • Help refine internal workflows, templates, and SOPs to improve efficiency and scalability Qualifications • 2–5 years of experience in executive search, recruiting, or research preferred • Strong interviewing instincts and ability to assess talent beyond resumes • High attention to detail and ability to synthesize information quickly • Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and Boolean search required • Familiarity with ATS systems such as Loxo preferred • Strong written communication skills, especially in summarizing candidates clearly and concisely • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment What Success Looks Like in This Role • You consistently surface high-quality candidates who align with the role’s true needs • You reduce time spent on unqualified or misaligned candidates • Your screening identifies “drivers” of scale, not “riders” of ---------- ntum • Your candidate summaries are clear, accurate, and decision-ready • You improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the overall search process Who You Are • A sharp evaluator of talent who can read between the lines • Naturally curious, with a strong instinct to probe deeper • Highly accountable and comfortable operating with autonomy • Structured, detail-oriented, and process-driven • Comfortable working behind the scenes but motivated by impact Why Join Crimson Jay You will work directly with the Founder on high-impact executive searches tied to real business outcomes, including growth, transformation, and exit readiness. This is an opportunity to learn how elite executive search is actually done, with a focus on judgment, quality, and precision, not volume. You will gain exposure to private equity-backed companies, founder-led businesses, and top-tier operators, while building a highly transferable skill set in talent evaluation, business strategy, and executive hiring.

title: Media Buyer — Virtual Assistant (Remote, Hourly)
description: Joburn Pte. Ltd. We're an AI-powered growth agency. We've driven over $5M in client revenue in two years — our flagship client went from $15K/month to over $1M ARR under our system. We don't do "run some ads and see what happens." We build compounding growth machines: diagnostic audits, analytics pipelines, ad creative engines, CRM automation, and conversion tracking — all wired together so every dollar spent teaches us something. The agency is scaling from a handful of high-touch clients to 50+ Growth Partner accounts. That's where you come in. What you're actually doing You're the person who makes sure campaigns are built right, running clean, and improving every week. Here's what a typical day looks like: Morning: Check in via Slack standup. Review yesterday's ad performance across client accounts in Meta Ads Manager. Flag anything bleeding money. Mid-day: Launch new ad sets, swap out fatigued creatives, adjust budgets based on CPA and ROAS trends. Most of this takes 30–60 minutes per client — not days. Afternoon: Pull performance data, build client reports that actually say something useful (not just screenshots of dashboards), and feed winning patterns back into our system so the next round of creative is sharper than the last. You'll work primarily inside Meta Ads Manager (Facebook + Instagram), with more platforms coming as we scale. You'll also touch GoHighLevel (our CRM — tracking leads from ad click to closed deal), ---------- (automation that routes creatives, pulls data, and syncs everything), and Supabase (where all the performance data lives). You don't need to be an expert in all of those on day one. But you need to be fluent in Ads Manager. That's non-negotiable. The AI part — read this carefully Our system uses AI for roughly 90–95% of the operational work. Claude writes first-draft ad copy. ---------- routes it through approval flows. HeyGen and ElevenLabs produce video creative. Supabase stores and surfaces the analytics. Your job is the final 5–10%. The part that actually determines whether the money was well spent. You're checking that campaign structures make sense, audiences are right, budgets aren't misconfigured, and nothing's quietly wasting spend at 2am. That 5–10% is where the skill lives. AI can generate. You d ---------- what ships. And here's the part most job posts won't say: at some point, AI will handle media buying end-to-end. The people who thrive here are the ones who treat AI as a tool that makes them faster — not a threat they're competing against. If you understand that and want to be on the right side of it, we want to talk. What we need from you Must-haves: Hands-on experience in Facebook Ads Manager. You've spent real budgets, managed real campaigns, and made real optimization decisions. Not "I completed a course." You should be able to open an unfamiliar ad account, audit what's running, and tell us what's broken within 30 minutes. You think in hours, not days. When something needs doing, you do it now. Most tasks here are 30–60 minutes, maybe two hours. "I'll get to it by end of week" doesn't work here. Analytical instinct. You see a CPL spike and you already have three hypotheses before anyone asks. Detail obsession. Wrong UTM parameters, mismatched audiences, typos in ad copy — that stuff should physically bother you. Rock-solid internet. Not "usually fine." You're managing live ad spend. A dropped connection at the wrong time costs real money. Good to have: Experience with GoHighLevel, ---------- , or any CRM/automation platform Comfort working alongside AI tools (if you already use ChatGPT or Claude for work, say so) Experience building client-facing performance reports — not just pulling numbers, but explaining what they mean and what to do next What you get Hourly role. You start at a rate that reflects where you are right now. Prove you can execute, and the rate moves up. We don't cap people who deliver results. Performance incentives tied to the outcomes you drive. We reward people who make our clients money. Training on our systems. You'll learn our AI stack, our creative frameworks, our reporting standards. We invest in people who are in it for real — but we can't teach you how to think. The foundations need to already be there. A seat at a small, fast team. This isn't a 200-person agency where you're a cog. You'll work directly with the people building the system. Your input shapes how we operate. 100% remote. Work from wherever. Just be reachable, be fast, and deliver. To apply Reply with the subject line: "The capital of Japan is [your answer]" If you can't follow that one instruction, we already have our answer.

title: Google product lister
description: We are a fast-growing e-commerce company operating one US-based dropshipping clothing store, with multiple additional stores currently being built. We are currently looking for an experienced Product Lister who can independently and efficiently add high-converting products to our Shopify stores while strictly following our internal SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and quality standards. This role is highly detail-oriented. We care much more about accuracy, consistency, and quality than speed alone. Payment: • Starting at $3 USD per fully completed and approved product listing • The price per listing can increase quickly based on quality, consistency, speed, and reliability • Long-term work available for reliable and high-quality team members What will you do? • Add products to our Shopify stores following our structured SOP workflow • Write and optimize SEO-focused product titles and descriptions • Upload product images and product data according to our internal guidelines • Properly categorize, tag, and organize products for visibility and scalability • Maintain a clean, premium, and conversion-focused product presentation • Create clear and professional sizing charts • Ensure all product content complies with Google Shopping Ads policies • Make small graphic design adjustments such as changing colors, backgrounds, or simple product image edits when needed • Carefully follow quality-control checklists before products go live What do we expect from you? • Proven experience with Shopify product listing (preferably for dropshipping or fashion brands) • Ability to work fast while maintaining very high accuracy and attention to detail • Strong understanding of SEO and keyword optimization • Experience working with Shopify product management • Experience using ChatGPT to improve and speed up product descriptions • Strong understanding of Google Shopping Ads policies and restrictions • Basic graphic design/editing skills (changing colors, editing simple product visuals, etc.) • You must be able to strictly follow SOPs and listing instructions • Put the word BALI in your subject line. Nothing else is required in the subject. • You understand exactly what is allowed — and what must be strictly avoided — in product titles, descriptions, and product pages for Google Ads compliance • Good English communication skills • Strong attention to detail and consistency • We are extremely strict on quality. Sloppy work, poor formatting, incorrect variants, weak descriptions, or non-compliant listings will not be accepted. What do we offer? • Long-term collaboration within a fast-growing international e-commerce company • Strong opportunities to grow within the company • Fast salary growth for team members who consistently deliver high-quality work • Bonus structures and performance-based rewards • The opportunity to take on more responsibility over time • A serious and professional working environment with room for personal growth HOW TO APPLY Read this section carefully. Applications that do not follow these instructions will be rejected without review. In your application message, answer these 5 questions in order. Answer each inline. No attachments or Loom videos at this stage. Q1. How long have you worked with Shopify product listing, and for what types of ecommerce businesses (dropshipping, DTC, marketplace, fashion, etc.)? Please name the actual companies/stores you worked for and explain your role in detail. Q2. Describe your full workflow when adding a product to Shopify from start to finish. Include: • Product title creation • SEO optimization • Product descriptions • Variant setup • Image optimization • Collection/tag organization • Size charts • Google Shopping compliance checks Q3. We are very strict about Google Shopping Ads compliance. Explain what is allowed and what should be avoided in: • Product titles • Product descriptions • Pricing • Claims • Product images to prevent Merchant Center suspensions or misrepresentation issues. Q4. What tools and software have you used? Examples: • Shopify • ChatGPT • Canva • Google Sheets • Matrixify • DSers • AutoDS • Other listing/research tools Also explain how many products per day you can comfortably and accurately upload while maintaining quality. Q5. Confirm your availability: • Hours per day • Days per week • Your local timezone and working hours • Are you currently employed? • If yes, what would your start date look like? IMPORTANT: After your application, selected candidates will receive a short test assignment. You will receive 2 AliExpress product links and will need to create 2 complete Shopify-ready product listings following our SOPs and formatting standards: • Optimized product titles • Product descriptions • Product tags/categories • Sizing information • Properly formatted Shopify-ready product presentation in a Word document Quality, structure, consistency, and attention to detail are extremely important to us.
