title: Contract Opportunity Analyst
description: JOB DESCRIPTION Contract Opportunity Analyst Remote (Philippines-Based) · Full-Time or Part-Time Position Overview We are seeking a detail-oriented Contract Opportunity Analyst to review publicly posted U.S. government and commercial contract solicitations and determine whether they represent viable opportunities for our business to pursue. This is a remote research role that requires strong reading comprehension, analytical judgment, and the ability to learn the fundamentals of American contracting. You will be the first filter in our business development pipeline — your assessments directly shape which opportunities we invest time and resources into. Day-to-Day Responsibilities Daily Contract Review Log in to assigned contract portals ( ---------- , GovWin, DIBBS, state procurement sites, etc.) and search for newly posted solicitations relevant to our service areas. Read the full solicitation package including the Statement of Work (SOW), Performance Work Statement (PWS), or Statement of Objectives (SOO). Identify key details: contract type, estimated value, period of performance, place of performance, submission deadline, and set-aside status (e.g., small business, 8(a), SDVOSB, WOSB). Opportunity Scoring & Qualification Compare solicitation requirements against our company’s capabilities, past performance, and certifications. Flag requirements that may be difficult to meet (bonding, security clearance, specific licenses, incumbency advantage, geographic restrictions). Rate each opportunity using our internal Go/No-Go scoring rubric and provide a brief written summary with your recommendation. Document Management & Reporting Enter opportunity data into our tracking spreadsheet or CRM system with all relevant fields completed accurately. Attach or link to key documents (solicitation, attachments, amendments). Send a daily or weekly digest of reviewed opportunities to the business development team. Monitor active solicitations for amendments or Q&A postings and flag any changes that affect our pursuit decision. Research Support Look up agency spending history and past contract awards on ---------- . Research the incumbent contractor when one is listed and note their size, performance history, and likely advantage. Identify the Contracting Officer or Contracting Officer’s Representative (CO/COR) contact information for outreach. Required Knowledge: Contracting Fundamentals This role requires you to learn and apply the following concepts. Training will be provided, but a strong candidate will research these independently as well. Contract Types Firm Fixed Price (FFP) — contractor delivers for a set price; most common. Time & Materials (T&M) — government pays for hours worked plus materials. Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF) — government reimburses costs plus a fixed profit. Indefinite Delivery / Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) — umbrella vehicles with task orders. Blanket Purchase Agreements (BPA) and Government-Wide Acquisition Contracts (GWACs) such as GSA Schedules, SEWP, CIO-SP3. Set-Asides & Socioeconomic Programs Small Business (SB), Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB), 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB (Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned), and WOSB (Women-Owned) set-asides. Why set-asides matter: they restrict competition to qualifying firms, which can dramatically improve win probability. NAICS codes — the industry classification system used to define contract scope and size standards. The Solicitation Document Types Request for Proposal (RFP) — full competitive procurement; requires a technical and price proposal. Request for Quote (RFQ) — typically for smaller or simpler purchases; less formal. Sources Sought / Request for Information (RFI) — market research only; no award made. description: About Us We're a US-based fiber arts studio. We design and sell needlepoint kits, hand-dyed yarn, embroidery kits, and fiber arts accessories — inspired by books, mythology, and folklore. We sell through our own Shopify store, Etsy, TikTok Shop, and wholesale via Faire, and we run a monthly subscription box for our community. We're a small, creative business run by a founder who cares deeply about quality, craft, and doing things right. We're growing steadily and building the team to support that — which is why we're hiring. This is a long-term role. We're not looking for someone to patch a gap. We're looking for someone to grow with us. The Role We're hiring a part-time Ecommerce Operations VA to start at 20 hours per week, with a clear path to 30–40 hours as the business grows. You'll be the operational backbone of our online store — keeping our Shopify catalog accurate and current, managing our monthly subscription box cycle, handling fulfillment coordination, and supporting the day-to-day tasks that keep a multi-channel ecommerce business running smoothly. You'll work directly with the founder and have real ownership of your responsibilities from early on. --- What You'll Be Doing Shopify & Catalog Management (primary focus) - Add new products to Shopify with complete detail: titles, descriptions, variants, pricing, tags, images, collections, and inventory tracking - Update existing product listings — pricing changes, seasonal updates, retired variants, restocks - Audit the catalog regularly for errors, missing images, or inconsistencies - Manage product visibility across sales channels as directed Monthly Subscription Box Support - Pull the monthly order report from Shopify and build the fulfillment list in Google Sheets - Add subscription-exclusive products to Shopify each month - Use existing Canva templates to build the monthly insert cards and product labels — content is provided; your job is to build and format from the templates - Create shipping labels - Follow up with subscribers whose memberships are expiring or lapsed Fulfillment Coordination - Monitor orders for issues — address problems, payment holds, unfulfilled items - Follow up on lost or delayed shipments with carriers - Maintain a Google Sheets fulfillment tracker - Pull regular order and fulfillment reports and flag anything that needs attention Customer Service - Respond to customer inquiries via email - Handle return, exchange, and replacement requests within defined policy - Escalate anything outside your authority immediately --- What We're Looking For Non-negotiable: - Proven Shopify experience — you have added products, managed variants, worked with collections and inventory tracking on a real store. This is the core of the role and we need someone with experience coming into this role. - Strong written English — customer-facing communication and catalog copy both require clarity and professionalism - Detail-oriented — our products have many components and variants; accuracy matters - Reliable and consistent — we need someone who shows up, communicates proactively, and takes ownership Strongly preferred: - Experience with Canva for building from existing brand templates (not designing from scratch — we have templates; you build from them) - Experience with Google Sheets — building and maintaining tracking spreadsheets - Familiarity with Etsy Seller Hub or Faire (we'll train, but exposure helps) - Experience supporting a subscription box or monthly product drop cycle Nice to have: - Airtable experience - Klaviyo or email marketing platform experience - Ecommerce customer service experience --- Working Hours & Setup - Hours: 20 hours per week to start, growing to 30–40 as the business scales - Schedule: Flexible, but we ask for at least a few hours of overlap somewhere within 9am–8pm Pacific Time (PST) during the initial onboarding period - Long-term: Once fully onboarded and operating independently, we're open to a fully async arrangement that works for your schedule - Communication: We use Google Chat for daily async communication and Loom for walkthroughs and training - Tools you'll use: Shopify, Canva, Google Sheets, Etsy Seller Hub, Faire, Gorgias --- Compensation - $5.50–$7.00 USD per hour depending on experience - Paid bi-weekly via Wise or Payoneer - Hours and compensation will grow alongside the business --- How to Apply Please send your application through OnlineJobs.ph and include: 1. A brief introduction — who you are, where you're based, and a summary of your ecommerce VA experience 2. Your resume or work history, with specific mention of any Shopify stores you've supported — plus at least one screenshot showing you working inside a Shopify admin (product listing, order management, catalog, or similar). You're welcome to blur or crop out the store name if needed; we just want to see that you're familiar with the platform firsthand. 3. Your answer to the following question — please answer thoroughly, as this is how we evaluate Shopify knowledge: "Describe the steps you would take to add a new product to Shopify that has multiple variants — for example, three different colorways of the same product. Include: how you would set up the variants, how you'd handle inventory tracking per variant, and how you'd add the product to a specific collection. If you've worked with subscription products or bundle products before, briefly mention how." 4. Your available hours per week and any time zone overlap you can offer with Pacific Time (PST) 5. Your hourly rate expectation if different from the range listed One last thing: To show us you've read this posting all the way through, please start your application message with the word "Folklore." This is an attention-to-detail check. Following instructions carefully is a core part of this role, and this is the easiest way to demonstrate it from the very first message. A Note on What This Role Grows Into: Right now this is 20 hours a week. We intend this role to grow in hours, in scope, and in responsibility. We want someone who's excited to be part of that journey. If you're reliable, detail-oriented, take ownership of your work, and genuinely enjoy the operational side of running a creative ecommerce business, we'd love to hear from you.

If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. What You’ll Actually Do You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs: Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin) Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you Who This Is NOT For You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5 You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure Who This IS For You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here. Comp & Growth Start: $800/mo PH based, full time during 90 day trial. When you consistently hit our KPIs (Output, D3 standards, owns Slack/Asana, Culture score), & take on much more responsibility, total comp moves to $1,000/mo target month 4. High performers who carry more scope over time can earn $1,100–$1,200+ with expanded responsibility. Raises and benefits are tied directly to beating KPIs, & raising the standard, not time served If you crush it, scope grows into higher-level ops ownership and comp follows output. No ceiling. This is what you make it. How To Apply Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine): Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove fro ---------- ssy start to completion without delegating. What tools did you use to track it, what were the exact deliverables, and what was the measurable result? Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each. Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders. Also attach your PDF/Googledrive resume link Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.

description: ## About the role We’re hiring a Virtual Assistant (VA) Video Editor to produce daily content for multiple sleeping/relaxation YouTube channels. The work is simple and repetitive, but it requires consistency, attention to detail, and the ability to use AI tools to create content quickly at scale. This is a monthly, long-term position for someone who wants stable work and is willing to learn and improve the workflow over time. ## What you’ll be creating each day You will produce 10 long-form videos per day, each 1 to 3 hours long. The editing style is intentionally minimal and follows a repeatable template. Each video includes: 1. Intro section: 5 short AI-generated video clips plus a short/long voiceover segment. 2. Veo3 & Nano Banana (GenAI) 2. Leonardo AI for generating images (Secondary Option) ## Responsibilities In this role, you will: - Edit and export 10 sleeping/relaxation videos daily (1–3 hours each). - Use the provided GenAI tools/accounts to generate the 5 intro clips and create/source images for the remainder of each video. - Add a short voiceover at the beginning/long voiceover for some historic videos (we will provide the voiceover with script). - Add music + images only for the rest of the video. title: Master Transactor (Transaction Coordinator ++)
description: About us Build Vacations is a U.S.-based short-term rental development company. We partner with investors to acquire, develop, and operate exceptional vacation properties — and we believe that every detail of that process matters. We're a small, tight-knit team that values radical candor, personal growth, and shared success. We use AI tools as a core part of our workflow, and we move fast — which means we need someone precise, proactive, and extremely organized. Don't worry about the AI, we will teach you. The role You will be the central document control point for the company — tracking, organizing, and managing documentation for every real estate transaction, development project, and corporate record we touch. This is not a passive filing role. You will coordinate deadlines, chase missing documents, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks across acquisitions, financing, permitting, and construction. If you are the kind of person who gets genuine satisfaction from a perfectly organized folder system and a checklist with every box checked, this role was built for you. What you'll own Coordinating purchase, sale, and financing transactions from contract through closing Managing escrow and title documentation, tracking closing timelines, and coordinating with brokers, attorneys, lenders, and title companies Maintaining transaction checklists with disciplined naming conventions and version control Organizing development and permitting documents, tracking submission and approval timelines Sorting and routing documents into appropriate AI tools and knowledge systems (Google Drive, NotebookLM, Claude, etc.) Managing corporate records: LLC documents, operating agreements, annual filings, investment agreements Proactively identifying missing documentation before deadlines hit — never waiting to be asked You're a great fit if you... Have 2–5+ years in real estate transaction coordination, paralegal work, or document management Can recognize and immediately understand documents like purchase agreements, title commitments, closing statements, escrow instructions, and loan origination documents Are comfortable working in Google Drive, DocuSign, PDF editing tools, and spreadsheet tracking Have used or are genuinely curious about AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, NotebookLM, or similar) Communicate clearly and professionally in both English and Spanish Are energized by process, routine, and precision — not overwhelmed by it This role is not for you if... You prefer to improvise your organization systems or "figure it out as you go" You wait for someone to tell you what's missing instead of hunting it down yourself Detailed document tracking feels tedious rather than satisfying Application screening — please read carefully We review every application that follows these instructions completely. Incomplete applications will not be considered. Loom video — 2 to 6 minutes Record a Loom video ( ---------- — free to use) and paste the link in your application. What system do you use, and why? Be specific about naming conventions, folder structure, or tools. 2. Describe a time you caught a missing document or deadline before it became a problem. Tell us which tools you've used (Claude, ChatGPT, NotebookLM, or others), how you've applied them to real estate or document workflows, and what worked — or didn't. 5. Read this phrase aloud at some point during your video: "Build Vacations — details matter, deposits follow." We are not looking for a perfect video. We are looking for clear thinking, calm communication, and someone who follows instructions precisely. How to apply Submit your application through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line: Master Transactor — [Your Name] Your application must include: • Your Loom video link • A brief paragraph on why this role is the right fit for you — specifically Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be reviewed. title: Customer Support Team Lead
description: We’re looking for a Support Team Lead to own day-to-day performance, coaching, and quality across our APAC/EMEA support team. This is a working lead role - You’ll carry your own case queue alongside leading the team. What makes this role different is the AI layer. Tixel runs an AI support agent that handles and triages a growing volume of customer contacts. Our approach to AI is simple: it’s there to support customers with fast, accurate resolutions and to provide clear paths to a human where it’s really needed. AI supports the team; it doesn’t replace it. That means this role isn’t just about leading people. It’s about being sharp enough to know when the AI is getting it wrong, why, and what needs to change. You’ll be a key voice in improving how our AI support layer serves customers, through structured QA, documented feedback, and direct input into the knowledge base that powers it. You’ll report directly to the Global Support Operations Manager (based in Australia). WHAT YOU’LL DO Team Leadership & Culture * Lead a team of 6-7 APAC and EMEA-based support agents - owning their day-to-day performance, development, and wellbeing * Run structured 1:1s and coaching sessions grounded in QA data, not gut feel. * Build genuine team culture in a remote, async-first environment where agents feel connected, clear on expectations, are proud of their work and want to actively contribute. * Lead calmly under pressure during event days, escalation spikes, and peak periods Case Execution * Carry an active personal caseload (~60–70% of a standard agent workload) alongside your leadership responsibilities * Own escalated and high-impact cases — fulfilment failures, payment edge cases, time-sensitive event-day issues * Hold authority to approve goodwill gestures and exceptions within defined policy limits * Set the standard for communication quality, case ownership, and follow-through on your team AI Support Quality & Knowledge * Conduct weekly structured QA reviews of AI-handled contacts — assessing tone alignment, policy accuracy, resolution quality, and failure patterns * Document specific failure examples with context and escalate findings to the knowledge base owner with clear recommendations * Validate knowledge base updates before they go live — flag edge cases and risks before they reach customers * Participate in QA calibration sessions to maintain scoring consistency across US, APAC and UK/EU * Bring analytical curiosity to how the AI support layer behaves — you’re not building it, but you’re one of the people responsible for making it better Agent QA & Coaching * Be formally accountable for weekly QA scoring of agent-handled contacts using our company rubric framework * Deliver structured coaching and feedback that is specific, tied to outcomes, and tracked over time * Identify performance gaps early and resource them appropriately before they become systemic * Report QA outcomes, performance trends, and coaching progress to Global Support Ops weekly Operational Monitoring & Roster * Monitor inbox health, queue volumes, escalation rates, and workflow performance throughout each shift * Identify emerging trends, product issues, or operational risks early and escalate with documented examples, volume indicators, and recommended actions * Own the fortnightly roster to ensure coverage meets demand across all queues and peak periods * Identify capacity gaps in advance — don’t let resourcing risks arrive as service failures WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Experience * 3+ years in customer support, with at least 1 year in a team lead, senior agent, or QA role * Demonstrated track record of coaching agents and lifting team performance through structured, evidence-based feedback * Zendesk experience required * Exposure to AI support tools or automation-assisted support - you don’t need to build them, but you need to understand how they behave and where they break * Experience with QA frameworks or rubric-based case evaluation - formal BPO QA background is a strong advantage * Background in marketplace, e-commerce, ticketing, or payments is highly regarded Skills & Attributes * Exceptional written and conversational English — this role is written-first across Zendesk, Slack, and async tools, but may occasionally require customer phone calls * Analytical mindset — you spot patterns in conversations and data before you’re asked to * Strong ownership mentality — you identify the problem and move, without waiting to be told * Comfortable with autonomy in a distributed, async-first environment across time zones * Calm and decisive under pressure, particularly during event-day peaks * Genuinely curious about AI in support — not just aware of it, but interested in how it can be improved * Aligned with our company values: direct, customer-first, accountable and passionate about live experiences HOW WE WORK * Remote-first, async-heavy — we communicate in writing, move fast, and don’t schedule meetings for things that can be a message * OKR-driven with Quarterly planning cycles — your work ladders up to team and company objectives * Weekly 1:1s with your manager, fortnightly all-hands, regular team rituals that keep distributed teams connected * Core tooling: Zendesk, Slack, Notion, Google Drive, Zoom — and an AI support layer you’ll actively help manage * Willingness to work weekends, public holidays, and peak event periods is essential for this role

title: Betting Operations & VM Management Assistant
description: OPENING STATEMENT We are looking for a full-time Betting Operations & VM Management Assistant to join a growing Australian professional betting operation. Your main job will be managing a fleet of Windows virtual machines that run automated betting software. Every day, you will log into each VM using remote desktop tools, check that the betting software is running, confirm that bookmaker accounts are logged in, fix any issues that come up, and keep accurate records of everything. On busy race days (especially Saturdays), you will need to check more often because bookmakers can log out mid-session. You will also help with small admin tasks like signing up to new bookmaker accounts as the operation grows. If you have experience in online operations, VM management, remote desktop work, data entry, betting admin, or similar detail-heavy technical roles - and you are comfortable doing repetitive work to a high standard every day - we want to hear from you. WHAT WE OFFER * Full-time, stable, long-term role with an Australian business. * 40 hours per week, Wednesday to Sunday. * 20,000php starting salary during probation. 23,500php + 1,500php benefits post probation (~1month) * Full training provided on all systems and tools. * Fully remote - work from home. * 13th month pay. * Government-mandated benefits. WHAT YOU'LL DO (TRAINING PROVIDED) * Log into Windows virtual machines via remote desktop every day and check that they are running correctly. * Monitor automated betting software on each VM - confirm sessions are active, bookmakers are logged in, and there are no errors. * On Saturdays and busy race days, check VMs more frequently to catch bookmakers that log out mid-session. * Fix common issues - restart frozen VMs, re-log bookmaker accounts, restart betting software sessions. * Escalate infrastructure-level problems (proxy connections, VPN, server issues) to the technical support team. * Maintain accurate tracking records - account balances, VM statuses, and operational data. * Sign up to new bookmaker accounts as instructed, following the exact process provided. * Provide daily updates to the owner on the state of the operation. REQUIREMENTS * Technically proficient - you pick up new software quickly and can troubleshoot basic issues independently. * Comfortable working inside Windows remote desktop environments for extended periods. * Strong attention to detail - the same checks across many VMs every day, and accuracy matters. * Genuinely comfortable with repetitive, routine work done to a high standard. * Proactive communicator - you raise issues immediately, not later. * Available to work Wednesday to Sunday, including Saturday mornings from 9:00am AEST. * Reliable computer and stable internet connection. NICE TO HAVE * Prior experience in betting operations, matched betting, or bookmaker account management. * Experience with automated betting tools. * Experience using Airtable or similar tracking tools. * Experience with remote desktop tools (RDM, AnyDesk, TeamViewer). SCHEDULE * Full-time, 40 hours per week. * Wednesday to Sunday, 8 hours per day. * Weekdays: 11:00am to 7:00pm AEST. * Saturdays: 9:00am start. * Australian timezone (AEST/AEDT). If you enjoy keeping systems running, doing detail-heavy work accurately, and being relied on to manage things independently - apply now. Click Send Email . Once your application is submitted, you will receive an email from us with the next steps and instructions for the hiring process.

title: Shopify & eBay eCommerce Content and Catalogue Manager
job_title: Shopify & eBay eCommerce Content and Catalogue Manager
description: The Shopify & eBay eCommerce Content and Catalogue Manager is responsible for the accuracy, structure, optimisation, and performance of Uniqleen’s online product catalogue across Shopify and eBay. This role owns product data integrity, product content creation, product listings, collection/category structure, on-site SEO execution, internal linking, digital merchandising, and eBay inventory/listing management to improve search visibility, navigation clarity, customer experience, and conversion performance. Uniqleen is primarily a B2C eCommerce business, with a less complex setup than a large B2B catalogue, but the role still requires strong attention to detail, strong Shopify experience, strong product content skills, and the ability to manage product information consistently across multiple sales channels. This role also requires the ability to use AI tools responsibly as part of a controlled eCommerce content workflow, including drafting, rewriting, improving, checking, and scaling product content without compromising accuracy, originality, or product data integrity. * This is not a social media or paid ads role. * This is not a developer role. * This is a catalogue, content, marketplace, structure, and optimisation role. * This role includes Shopify catalogue management, product content creation, and eBay listing/inventory management. * This role requires strong quality control over all manually written and AI-assisted product content. Key Responsibilities 1. Product & Catalogue Management * Create, update, and maintain product listings across Shopify and eBay, including titles, descriptions, bullet points, variants, images, PDFs, specifications, pricing, and inventory information. * Manage product data in bulk using Shopify CSVs or third-party tools such as Matrixify/Excelify where required. * Maintain accurate product titles, descriptions, images, SKUs, barcodes, pricing, stock status, tags, metafields, and product categorisation. * Manage product variants such as sizes, colours, pack quantities, fragrances, bundle options, or other relevant variations. * Ensure product information is consistent, accurate, and customer-friendly across all sales channels. * Maintain clear naming conventions that align with SEO, customer search behaviour, and internal catalogue structure. * Prevent duplicate products, inconsistent URLs, incorrect variants, and duplicated listing content. * Ensure discontinued, out-of-stock, or replaced products are handled correctly across Shopify and eBay. * Maintain catalogue accuracy across product names, specifications, pack sizes, product types, usage details, and channel-specific listing requirements. 2. Product Content Creation & Optimisation * Write, edit, and optimise product titles, descriptions, bullet points, specifications, and SEO metadata for Shopify and eBay. * Create clear, accurate, customer-friendly product content that explains product type, key benefits, pack size, usage, compatibility, and important specifications. * Ensure product copy is suitable for B2C customers and written in a way that supports both search visibility and conversion. * Adapt product content appropriately between Shopify and eBay, ensuring eBay listings include strong titles, item specifics, marketplace-friendly descriptions, and relevant keywords. * Maintain a consistent tone, structure, and naming convention across the product catalogue. * Rewrite supplier/manufacturer content into clean, original, useful product copy while avoiding duplicate content and unsupported claims. * Ensure all product claims, technical details, safety information, dimensions, sizes, ingredients, compatibility, and pack information are checked against reliable source material before publishing. * Create and maintain content templates for different product types to keep product pages consistent and scalable. * Ensure product descriptions and bullet points are useful, factual, easy to scan, and aligned with customer buying intent. * Improve existing product content where descriptions are thin, duplicated, unclear, overly technical, or not optimised for customer search behaviour. 3. AI-Assisted eCommerce Content Workflow * Use AI tools responsibly to support product content creation, SEO optimisation, bulk content drafting, title refinement, description rewriting, bullet point generation, keyword expansion, and catalogue clean-up. * Create effective AI prompts and workflows that produce structured, accurate, brand-appropriate eCommerce content. * Review, edit, fact-check, and improve AI-generated content before publishing. * Use AI to increase efficiency without compromising accuracy, originality, compliance, or product data integrity. * Avoid publishing unverified AI-generated claims, incorrect specifications, duplicated content, generic low-value copy, or unsupported product statements. * Maintain human quality control over all AI-assisted product content. * Use AI to improve workflow efficiency while still relying on verified product data, supplier information, manufacturer specifications, and internal catalogue standards. * Build repeatable content workflows for scaling product updates across large batches of products while maintaining accuracy and consistency. 4. Shopify Collection & Site Architecture * Build and maintain logical Shopify collection structures. * Optimise categories and collections for customer navigation and search engine indexing. * Create and manage smart collections, manual collections, product filters, and tags. * Maintain internal linking between related products, categories, and collections. * Improve navigation and product discovery across the website. * Ensure best-selling, seasonal, promotional, and high-priority products are merchandised effectively. * Monitor and improve collection layouts to support conversion and customer browsing behaviour. * Maintain clean taxonomy across products, collections, product types, tags, and filters. 5. eBay Listing & Inventory Management * Create, update, and optimise eBay product listings. * Ensure eBay titles, item specifics, categories, images, descriptions, pricing, postage details, and returns information are accurate and competitive. * Manage eBay inventory accuracy, including stock availability, SKU matching, and listing status. * Monitor overselling risks and ensure Shopify/eBay stock levels remain aligned where applicable. * Update eBay listings for price changes, discontinued items, new products, bundle changes, or promotional updates. * Maintain consistency between Shopify product data and eBay listing content. * Optimise eBay listings using relevant keywords, item specifics, and category best practices. * Identify and resolve eBay listing errors, suppressed listings, policy issues, duplicate listings, and inventory discrepancies. * Support eBay marketplace performance by improving listing quality, visibility, and customer-facing product information. * Ensure Shopify SKUs and eBay SKUs are correctly mapped where inventory sync or channel integration tools are used. 6. On-Site SEO Execution * Optimise Shopify product titles, meta descriptions, URLs, headings, and product copy. * Identify keyword opportunities relevant to B2C customer search intent. * Improve product and collection content for organic search visibility. * Manage redirects for discontinued, renamed, or replaced products. * Avoid duplicate content and poor URL structures. * Collaborate on structured data/schema improvements using Shopify apps or theme settings where required. * Ensure product content is clear, useful, and aligned with both SEO and customer buying intent. * Improve thin, duplicated, or manufacturer-supplied product content to better support organic search performance. 7. description: THE COMPANY We are a web design agency that builds high-quality professional websites for established businesses across the United States. title: Systems Monitoring & Account Maintenance VA

work from home * Genuine scope for role growth into financial admin over time --- WHAT YOU'LL DO (TRAINING PROVIDED) * Log into multiple remote machines daily and confirm everything is running correctly * Restart software or machines that have stopped and ensure all systems are operational * Record account balances accurately in a spreadsheet * Review recent activity and flag anything unusual * Carry out small maintenance actions as directed * After 2-3 months, produce daily summaries of accounts needing attention and take on additional reporting tasks --- REQUIREMENTS * Strong attention to detail - accurate balance recording across many accounts is the core of this role and mistakes have direct consequences * Comfortable with REPETITIVE, ROUTINE WORK performed to a high standard every single day * AVAILABLE TO WORK 7 DAYS A WEEK, with days off taken Monday to Wednesday if needed * Able to maintain focus and consistency even on weekends or quieter shifts * Able to follow instructions from screen-recorded training sessions, take your own notes, and execute independently without needing things re-explained * Willing to speak up immediately when something is unclear rather than guessing * Comfortable learning and working inside remote desktop and browser-based software daily * Reliable internet connection and computer setup --- NICE TO HAVE * Experience with account management or similar monitoring roles * Experience with remote desktop tools (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, Chrome Remote Desktop) * Experience with multi-profile browsers or similar tools * Background in IT support, helpdesk, or systems monitoring --- SCHEDULE * Full-time, 40 hours per week * 7 days per week (days off Monday to Wednesday if needed) * Core hours: 11:00am to 4:00p ---------- lbourne time (AEST/AEDT) * Australian timezone (AEST/AEDT) --- This role suits someone who takes pride in doing the same job well every day, pays close attention to detail even on routine tasks, and is specifically looking for a structured, DAILY WORKLOAD rather than a standard weekday-only job. If that sounds like you - apply now.

description: About Us We are a Hong Kong-based technology company specializing in cutting-edge AI engine solutions and AI-powered consumer services. Our clients span across international markets, and we are building a high-performance remote team to accelerate global business growth. We are not looking for just anyone — we are looking for someone exceptional who thinks in numbers, not just in feelings. Role: B2B Sales & Business Development Specialist Location: 100% Remote (Philippines-based) Salary: PHP 96,000/month (fixed) + performance incentive Hours: Full-time, Monday–Friday (flexible, aligned to HK/global client time zones) What You Will Do: - Conduct outbound prospecting via email , LinkedIn, and video calls to international B2B clients - Qualify leads and schedule high-value discovery calls / demos for senior stakeholders - Manage the full sales cycle from first contact through to close - Maintain accurate pipeline records in CRM (HubSpot or equivalent) - Track and analyze your own performance data weekly: outreach volume, reply rate, conversion rate, win rate — and adjust your approach based on what the numbers show Identify funnel bottlenecks using data, form clear hypotheses, and run experiments to improve them - Research target accounts, market trends, and competitor activity - Support marketing campaigns and business development initiatives Our Core Philosophy: Quantitative Before Qualitative At our company, every business problem is first analyzed with numbers. ? "I feel the campaign isn't working well." — this is NOT analysis. ? "Reply rate dropped from 4.2% to 1.8% week-over-week, likely caused by the subject line change on Tuesday." — this IS analysis. If you cannot define problems with data, you cannot solve them. We need someone who naturally reaches for numbers when something feels off, and who has actually done this in previous roles — not just heard about it. Requirements — Must Have - Graduate of a recognized university (you MUST include your university and degree in your application) - Business-level English — written and spoken. You will be assessed during the interview - Proven, hands-on experience analyzing sales or marketing performance using quantitative metrics — you have personally tracked KPIs, diagnosed problems through numbers, and acted on those insights in a real work setting - Comfort with spreadsheets (Excel / Google Sheets), funnel metrics (conversion rates, drop-off rates), and basic statistical thinking (averages, ratios, trends) - Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision - Strong reporting habits — you proactively flag issues before they become problems - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international environment Nice to Have (Strong Advantage) - Experience in BPO, multinational, or foreign-client-facing roles - Outbound sales track record (cold email / LinkedIn outreach / calling) with measurable results you can quote (e.g., "lifted reply rate from 1.5% to 3.8% over 6 weeks") - CRM experience (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar) — including building reports or dashboards - Closing experience with quotable numbers (e.g., "achieved 120% of quota in Q3") - Exposure to tech, SaaS, or AI-related industries Please Do NOT Apply If: - You analyze problems primarily through "feelings" or "general impressions" rather than numbers - You have never personally tracked your own KPIs or pulled data to diagnose a sales/marketing problem in your previous role - You expect your manager to identify problems for you — we need someone who finds them first, with data - You cannot provide proof of your university degree when requested - Your English communication is primarily written-only with limited spoken fluency - You require constant supervision to complete tasks - You are looking for a purely task-execution role with no ownership If we have to do the analytical thinking for you, hiring you defeats the purpose. Please be honest with yourself before applying. How to Apply — IMPORTANT: Read carefully. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed. To apply, please send your application to [EMAIL ] with the subject line exactly as written: "AI Sales – [Your Full Name] – [Your University]" Your application MUST include all of the following: 1. Your resume / CV (PDF format) 2. A 2–3 minute Loom video introduction (link required — see instructions below) 3. Answers to ALL FOUR screening questions below (in the body of your email ) Loom Video Instructions Record a short 2–3 minute video at ---------- (free) where you: - Introduce yourself in English (name, university, degree, years of experience) - Describe one specific situation where you used data or numbers to identify a problem at work — what were the numbers, what did you conclude, and what did you do? (vague answers will be rejected) - Tell us: What does "working independently" mean to you in practice? Screening Questions (answer all 4 in your email ) Q1. Which university did you graduate from, and what was your degree? Q2. Describe a time you had to reach a decision or solve a problem at work without clear instructions from your manager. What did you do, and what was the result? Q3. Have you used a CRM tool before? If yes, which one, and how did you use it specifically in your sales or BD role? Please include any numbers (e.g., pipeline value managed, conversion rates tracked, deals closed). Q4. (Quantitative Analysis Case — please answer with numbers) Imagine you sent 500 cold email s last month and received the following results: Open rate: 38% (industry average: 40%) Reply rate: 1.2% (industry average: 3%) Booked appointments: 2 Closed deals: 0 Based on these numbers alone: (a) Where is the biggest bottleneck in the funnel, and why? Cite specific numbers in your reasoning. (b) What two specific experiments would you run next month to improve this, and what result would tell you whether each experiment worked? Applications missing the Loom video, incorrect subject line, or incomplete answers — especially Q4 with vague non-numerical reasoning — will be automatically filtered out. We look forward to hearing from candidates who think in data.

DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DO NOT HAVE SUITABLE EXPERIENCE. * * Apply by via our job application portal ONLY: ---------- * * Join our dynamic team at Pahroo Appraisal and Consultancy, LLC, where we thrive on the fast-paced and ever-evolving real estate market. Our firm is renowned for delivering precise and reliable property valuations, contributing to the success of commercial and residential real estate decisions across the US. The Role As a Residential Real Estate Appraisal Analyst, you will delve into the complexities of property valuation, employing your analytical prowess and attention-to-detail to deliver top-notch reports. Your work will encompass a variety of property types, ensuring no two days are the same, yet also demand focus on specific tasks to meet our standards of accuracy and reliability. Ideal Candidate Analytical and Meticulous: You have a keen eye for detail and a methodical approach to research and analysis, ensuring no stone is left unturned in our quest for precision. Adaptable and Resilient: While you thrive under pressure and shifting priorities, you also appreciate the clarity of routine tasks and deadlines. You're capable of balancing variety with consistency, adapting your pace as needed. Technical and Focused: You are deeply engaged with the technical aspects of real estate appraisal and can concentrate on repetitive tasks when required without losing interest or efficiency. Reserved yet Communicative: Although reserved at first, you build warm connections over time. In groups, you may prefer listening, but you're articulate and factual when you do speak. Respectful and Procedure-Oriented: You value structure and clear directions, responding well to supportive leadership. You adhere strictly to rules and processes, with a high respect for authority. Independent yet Team-Oriented: After initial guidance, you seek a certain level of autonomy but are not shy to ask for help when needed. Your approach is cautious but purposeful, aiming for the highest standards. Creative and Open: You bring creativity to your analytical work and are open to new ideas and methodologies, which enhance your problem-solving capabilities. Tasks and Activities Perform research using industry acknowledged databases and tools used across US market Analyze property level information from various sources including income statements, rent rolls, reimbursements, occupancy statistics to put together an indication of value Prepare collateral monitoring reports for assets underlying debt/equity investments. The assets range from office, industrial, multifamily, self-storage, retail and others Perform valuation and appraisal services for residential real estate properties for the US markets and prepare reports for assets underlying debt/equity investments. title: Head of Operations for Fast-Growing Unique E-commerce Brand
job_title: Head of Operations for Fast-Growing Unique E-commerce Brand
description: Hi there! This is not your typical AI job post. A founder here speaking right from the heart. My name is Halil, and I am the founder of Miras, a sportswear start-up. We strive to create the best football shirts on planet earth. We have done so with our first launch, by creating a Turkish football shirt that received an unbelievable response. People instantly fell in love with it, and the demand has been unlike anything we have seen before. It feels like we are writing a new chapter in football shirt design. Now we want to go bigger with the World Cup. We are launching new products, new strategies... it will be truly amazing. We are aiming for 1,2 million in revenue at least in the next month and I need your help. We are ambitious. We have a lot of things to do, but I cannot run behind every single one of them unfortunately. Even though I want to. Therefore, I need you. Yes, you. You will oversee the daily operations, and do what's needed to turn our ideas into reality. I need a doer, I need a killer. I need someone that gets things done. If I have an idea, I will share it with you. If we both agree that it is worth pursuing, I want you to take ownership and make it happen. I need someone, who does not think in limitations, but in possibilities. If it means forming your own team, perfect. Do so. If it means hiring, perfect, do so. You will get the freedom. I need someone who knows what to do. I don't have time to teach you everything. And honestly, I don’t want to. I want to grow, I want you to grow. Fast. I will trust you. I hire you because you know it better than me. I will put my ego aside. Just join me, and let’s crush it. I want someone who understands that big things are built with people. I am a big believer in Who, not How. We can grow much faster if we focus on finding the right “who’s”, instead of trying to figure out every “how” ourselves. Right now, I am running behind too many things. That’s why I am hiring you. I need you to find other people who can get things done for you as well. Give them ownership, let them build their own team, and make sure they apply the same principle within their team too. I need someone who understands and lives up to this principle too. Someone who delegates fast, hires fast, and knows how to put the right people in the right places. The right amount of people, in the right roles. This is basically the formula for maximum execution and maximum output. This is how we get as many things done as possible, in the shortest amount of time. If you think this is me, please apply and let's crush it together. You might have noticed that I constantly say, "we". That's correct, because the brand is not mine, even though I might be the founder. It's ours, and I always reward my people. You don't just become my Head of Operations, you will become my buddy, the person I will see and speak to even more than my own father, mother, and siblings. If we hit that 1,2 million in revenue your salary will be doubled for that month. So that's a 2x bonus, an extra $2400/month, and $4800 USD in total. Must be a nice vacation bonus just around summer-time. The last thing I want to say is this: I just want to be very transparent. This is a start-up. I need your effort and your ownership. Sometimes that might mean working more than 8 hours. Sometimes that might mean working late in the evening. But it is all worth it, because football means so much to people. People wake up with it, sleep with it, talk about it, argue about it, cry about it, and celebrate because of it. We don’t call it the beautiful game for nothing. With Miras, we have the chance to make people genuinely happy, to make them feel proud, and to connect people through our own brand. That is what makes this worth it. Let's crush it!!! See you at the top. ???? Halil PS: You will oversee the following areas and build the systems needed to keep everything running smoothly: • Customer support • Chargebacks and payment disputes • Order fulfilment • Proactively monitoring order tracking, spotting delivery issues early, and solving them before they become bigger problems • Production coordination • Supply chain management • Finding creators who fit the Miras brand and reaching out to them for partnerships • Managing all communication with creators, making sure they are informed about everything,, and know exactly what to do • Collecting the creator’s shirt details, including custom name, number, size, and shipping address • Adding creator orders into our system correctly and making sure the custom shirt gets shipped to the creator • Following up with creators after delivery to make sure they create and send the content on time • Adding subtitles to creator videos, making basic edits where needed, and preparing the content for ads • Running ads with creator content and monitoring which videos perform well • Offering long-term collaborations to creators whose videos perform well in ads • Managing our creator referral system, where creators receive €25 for every new creator they refer to us • And anything else that I forgot or don't know of yet

I'm also building a short list of trusted candidates to reach out to as my team grows - so if you're excellent, there is a real path forward even if you're not the first hire. To Apply: Send a short note - 2–3 sentences max on why this role is a good fit for you. Include your answer to this: what is one US online furniture or décor retailer you really like, and why do you like it? Title your application message as follows, inserting your first name where indicated: Design Sourcing – [Your First Name] Applications that do not follow this format will not be reviewed. I run two small US e-commerce stores: one in commercial water and hydration systems (drinking fountains and bottle refill stations), and one in outdoor power and forestry equipment (log splitters, wood chippers, attachments). I'm looking for one friendly, English-fluent person to be the voice of both stores on live chat, email , and phone. The heart of the job is sales: helping people feel confident making a high-ticket purchase, guiding them to the right product, preparing quotes, and following up so we don't lose them. One store is established with a light, steady flow of inquiries. The other is new and growing fast, with strong projections for this year and next. You'd start by covering both because volume is low. As we grow, you'll focus on just one. A few honest things up front: - The workload is light right now. Think around two live chats and a couple of calls per store per day, plus preparing quotes. - You'll have real downtime, especially the first month but you will use this time to learn about the products and systems. The best people use it to follow up on open quotes and abandoned carts, because that's where the commission is. This role rewards initiative, not clock-watching. - The questions are mostly simple: order status, "which model fits my needs," basic product questions. Some technical ones come in. At first you'll pass those to me; over time you'll handle most yourself. Because the products are high-ticket (orders from hundreds to several thousand dollars), the one thing that really matters is clear, confident, natural English on the phone. You're helping people feel comfortable making a real purchase. That's the job. What you'll do: - Help customers pick the right product, answer their questions, and close the sale - Prepare and send quotes, then follow up on them by call and email - Recover abandoned checkouts by reaching out before the lead goes cold - Answer inbound live chats, email s, and phone calls for both stores - Call customers after delivery to check in and ask for a Trustpilot review - Handle the occasional refund, warranty, or shipping question (these are rare) - Keep simple notes updated in the CRM and pass anything technical to me (at first) - Light Shopify tasks as you settle in (optional) Required: - Sales experience (any role where you helped someone d ---------- to buy) - Customer service experience -Sales experience - Strong, natural spoken English and a great attitude (just as important as the experience) Strongly preferred: - Shopify experience (admin, orders, fulfillment) - Experience selling higher-priced or considered purchases, not just fast retail Compensation: $600 to $800+/month (base + uncapped commission) - Base: $600/month at 40 hrs/week - Commission: 0.4% - 1% of every sale you help close through pre-purchase chat, phone call, follow-up email , or abandoned-cart recovery. Organic website checkouts where you didn't interact with the customer don't count. - Review bonus: $10 per published Trustpilot review you bring in from post-purchase calls - There's no cap. The more you close, the more you make. Strong performers clear $800/month and up. Hours: 9 AM to 5 PM EST, Mon to Fri (US business hours) Tools we use: Go High Level CRM for phone, text, and live chat. How you'll learn the role: written SOPs and short video walkthroughs for both stores, plus a few live training calls with me in your first week or two. The first month is paid learning time, so curiosity and willingness to learn count. To apply, please submit: 1. Internet speed test result (50 Mbps+ preferred) 2. Typing speed test result (40+ WPM preferred) 3. One paragraph of your written English 4. A 45-second audio sample. Don't just introduce yourself, sell me. Pretend I'm a customer on the phone, on the fence about a $4,500 log splitter, and I ask: "Why shouldn't I just grab the cheaper one at my local store?" Talk me into feeling good about the bigger purchase. 5. In 3-4 sentences: tell me about the best sale you ever closed, or a tough customer you turned around. What did you actually do? 6. Your IQ score from your profile (required) 7. Your contact info Put your favorite dessert in the subject line so I know you actually read this. If your English is excellent, say so. I bump base pay for standout candidates. Looking forward to it. Facundo

What’s So Different Here? Our target is simple: to become THE place that every hungry superstar WANTS to work where they can and will achieve “rock legend” status. We want to help you dream big in your life and career… and we want to help you achieve it all. Who are we? We’re Stillwater Bath and Shower and Fort Collins Bath and Home Remodeling. Taylor has many years in the handyman and Bathroom Remodel fields in the Northern Colorado area. He is the Guru behind the service specific tasks and you could call him the Sales Super Hero. And we help others too – we’re strong supporters of making a difference and creating positive and everlasting memories for customers who have their showers and bathrooms remodeled. --- and it feels like we are only getting started. We recently moved into an office location, we’re adding more tea ---------- mbers, and you should see the plan we have for growth beyond this. Are You a Fit? Great Place To Work – We have each other’s backs. You look out for our customers and the company will look out for you. As an equal opportunity employer, candidates will receive consideration without discrimination against race, creed, color, sex, national origin, or veteran status. “WE HIRE VETERANS!!! Job Description Customer Service Representative Today is awesome! You showed up for work, mingled with the team, and made note of the priorities to start your day. You’ve got the education to understand what’s to be done… now it’s time to roll up your sleeves and put it into action. The day goes fast, production is occurring, and you are already looking forward to tomorrow. Job Duties: Work with the team: You stay in contact with your manager and your team to make sure the work orders are completed efficiently – everyone pitches in because it’s ultimately about serving the customer. There may be errands, and specific job duties because it’s also about serving the team. Develop your expertise: You’re answering phones, replying to email s, writing up estimates, customer interaction, knowing that you’re adding a positive experience to our customers lives through the services we offer. Over time, you gain a growing expertise in job scheduling, data entry (you are PC and computer literate: word, excel, power point), filing, ordering supplies, over the phone sales and scheduling appointments, ultimately learning all the services we offer. Become a trusted professional: You keep your desk neat, clean, and organized so everything’s handy and ready for use. You are VERY detail oriented. You’ll learn to use our software, handle money, understand job-scopes, and estimating too, because you’ll know that this keeps everyone informed – from the customer to the Service Experts to the team here at the office. You have excellent phone skills, get things done and customers like speaking with you. Each pathway to advancement opens doors for more pay. Our CSR’s start at $7.00/Hr the first month, $7.50/Hr  the 2nd month and then $8/Hr the 3rd month. After that, your base pay will hold there until promotions. Add in spiffs, bonuses, and incentives and that hourly pay can be $10+ an hour - easy! You love to learn: You have a high school diploma or equivalent. You don’t need experience to apply here but experience is a plus. Most importantly, you have a drive to learn more because you know that it serves everyone – from the customer to the team to yourself. You eagerly complete your training requirements and ask, “What’s next?” You’ll learn our culture, office routines, customer interaction, how to up-sell, and get an overview of our entire system and processes. You’re a tech-savvy people person: You love the challenge you’re posed with and the adventure of doing a job well done. At the same time, you’re comfortable talking to a homeowner, storeowner, or property manager and professionally educating them in what their options are. Service recommendations, technical information, cleaning agents? No problem. You’re ready to work: 8am to 5pm Monday through Friday. You have a driver’s license, reliable transportation, a ready-to-work attitude, and no problem facing the adventures of the day – such as calling on past-dues, announcing accolades to Service Experts, and turning another prospect into a happy customer. You’re a professional: Learning every aspect of the job. You look, speak, and dress like a professional. You keep your work area clean and orderly. You are focused and clear-headed. You don’t let mistakes slide by. You jump into difficult assignments. You complete projects by the deadline. You are level-headed and optimistic. You handle money and accounts very carefully. You face up to other people’s upsets and problems. You produce more than expected. Application: If this sounds like you, apply to this position and let us know why you’d be a great fit for our team! ? WHEN HIRED YOU will be ONLINE Everyday during Colorado’s business hours. You will be full time, working part time for still water and part time for Ft. Collins Bathroom and Home Remodeling.
